pages.title: A New Year Check-In: Are You Prepared If an Accident Happens This Year? - Parian Lawyers
pages.h1: A New Year Check-In: Are You Prepared If an Accident Happens This Year?
pages.content_md:
The beginning of the year is when people review budgets, update calendars, and reset routines. It’s also a good time to think about whether you’re prepared if something unexpected happens.

Being prepared doesn’t mean assuming the worst. It means knowing where you stand before you’re forced to figure it out under stress.

**Review Your Insurance Coverage**

Many people haven’t looked closely at their insurance policies in years. Minimum coverage often isn’t enough to cover serious injuries, and uninsured or underinsured motorist coverage can be more important than people realize. These gaps usually don’t become obvious until after an accident.

**Know What to Do After an Accident**

In the moments after a crash or injury, stress makes it hard to think clearly. Knowing when to call the police, when to take photos, and what information to gather can make a significant difference later. It’s also important to be careful about what you say to insurance companies before you fully understand your situation.

**Don’t Assume Minor Accidents Stay Minor**

Many injuries don’t show symptoms right away. Pain, stiffness, and other issues can take days or weeks to appear. Waiting too long to get medical care or ask questions can complicate recovery and any potential claim.

**Understand That Timing Matters**

Georgia law places limits on how long you have to take legal action after an injury. That clock often starts running sooner than people expect, even if treatment is ongoing.

**Start the Year Informed**

You don’t need to expect something bad to happen to be prepared. Having a basic understanding of your coverage, your options, and your next steps can help you feel more confident if the unexpected happens.

If an accident does happen, you don’t have to figure everything out on your own. Many people wait to ask questions because they don’t want to overreact or assume they’re entitled to anything. But understanding your rights early can help you make informed decisions and avoid costly mistakes.

At **Parian Lawyers**, we help people understand where they stand after an injury and what options may be available to them. A quick conversation can often provide clarity and peace of mind when things feel uncertain.

A wrongful death or serious injury caused by another person or company can leave people feeling lost and wandering. Our personal injury attorneys will be there with you every step of the way to calm you and inform you about key developments and events related to your injury claims. Our goal is for you to be taken care of from the moment you hire us as your personal injury lawyers. The personal injury claims process can be slow-moving. The law provides both the injured party and the at-fault party certain amounts of time to respond to each other. pages.title: Anniston Personal Injury Lawyer | Georgia Injury Claims Attorney
pages.description: Seek the assistance of an Anniston personal injury lawyer today to seek damages for any injuries sustained due to another person's negligence.
pages.content_md:
The unpredictability of life can be rattling sometimes. Regardless of how careful you are to protect yourself and your family, none of us can control the behaviors of others.

The negligence or careless conduct of others can turn your life upside down in seconds, potentially causing you to be unable to work. A serious injury can make it difficult to care for yourself and your family, as well as enjoy the hobbies and activities that brought so much joy to your life previously.

The worst scenario of all is if you lose a beloved family member in a wrongful death accident.

Has another person caused you or a loved one to be a victim of a personal injury? Has another person�s carelessness brought on the wrongful death of a loved one?

If so, you will need to engage an Anniston personal injury lawyer to assist you and your family with legal matters. Contact our experienced personal injury lawyers to work with you through your case, every step of the way.

Personal injuries take human life and create unbearable suffering, financial, physical and emotional, and to families who have lost a loved one.

Personal injuries can occur in countless ways. Set forth below is a brief description of some of the most common personal injury lawsuits that warrant attention from an Anniston personal injury attorney.

- Automobile Accidents. We are a country dependent upon automobile travel. In the United States, more than 1,000,000 people are injured in car accidents every year. In these automobile accidents, approximately 30,000 to 40,000 people are killed, every year. Many of these car accidents could have been avoided, and negligent driving is the primary cause.
- Truck Accidents. In a recent year, across the nation, 104,000 people were injured in a truck accident, and almost 4,000 people were killed in truck accidents. Given their size, truck drivers have large blind spots, so visibility is always a concern. Trucks take much longer to stop due to their heavy weight and are far less maneuverable.
- Workplace Accidents. Workplace injuries are an everyday occurrence in the United States. Over 23,000 job injuries occur in the country every single day. Per year, over 59,000 job-related injuries end in a death to the employee.
- Motorcycle Accidents. Clearly, motorcycle riders do not have the same protections as automobile drivers and passengers. They are prone to very serious injuries. Also, due to their smaller size, drivers sometimes do not spot them, causing grave injuries and increasing the need for an Anniston injury lawyer.
- Premises Liability. Premises liability accidents occur on someone else�s property caused by the negligence of the owner or manager of the premises. The two most common types are slip and fall accidents and accidents at swimming pools.
- Product Liability. When you buy something and use it for the purpose it was intended, you should not have to suffer harm due to the product.
- Nursing Home Abuse. Routinely, nursing home residents suffer from indignities, injuries, and abuse.

Personal injury accidents caused by another person�s negligence often result in very serious injuries to others, and sometimes even death. Personal injuries, of all types, happen every single day.

Have you or a loved one been a victim of a personal injury in Anniston? If so, our experienced Anniston personal injury lawyers are ready to work with you and your family to zealously fight for the compensation you deserve. Call our personal injury lawyers today.

pages.title: Anniston Bicycle Accident Lawyer | Bike Crash Attorney
pages.description: An Anniston bicycle accident lawyer could help you compile beneficial evidence and witnesses to present when seeking compensation for your injuries.
pages.content_md:
Bicycle accidents can happen anytime, anywhere. Bicycle riders also have very limited protection while they are riding, which means these accidents can cause catastrophic injuries. If were injured in a serious bicycle accident, you should not leave the outcome of your case to chance. An Anniston bicycle accident lawyer can look at the facts and determine whether you have a viable injury case. Speak with a driven and decisive personal injury attorney about the types of damages that may be applicable to your claim.

Bicycle accidents have many causes, some of which are legally compensable. In some instances, bicycle accidents occur when motor vehicle operators � including car, truck, and motorcycle operators � drive in a careless or reckless manner.

In some cases, defective bicycle parts can malfunction, leading to serious accidents. Sometimes bicycle operators may do something to cause or contribute to an accident. When that happens, they may be unable to recover compensation for their injuries.

When drivers drive distractedly or do something that is careless or negligent, then an injured bicycle accident victim may be able to file a claim or lawsuit. If that is the case, they will likely file the claim or lawsuit against the at-fault driver�s insurance company. As an Anniston bicycle accident lawyer knows, the adjuster for that insurance company will then determine whether the claim is viable.

If a bicycle parts manufacturer allowed a defective bicycle part or product to enter the market, then the accident victim may be able to file a claim against them. In product liability cases such as these, the product must normally be defective at the time it leaves the manufacturer�s hands. If the individual cannot settle a personal injury case with the at-fault party�s insurance company, they may need to file a lawsuit in the court system.

Alabama follows the doctrine of contributory negligence. Under that doctrine, if the bicyclist contributes to the accident by as little as one percent, then they may not be able to recover any damages whatsoever. Examples of contributory negligence include:

- Exiting a designated bicycle lane
- Failing to use appropriate hand signals when turning or slowing down
- Operating a bicycle on the wrong side of the road
- Entering the stream of traffic when it is unsafe to do so

If the insurance company suspects a bicycle operator contributed to the accident even slightly, it may deny liability or offer a measly settlement amount.

When bicyclists fall from their bicycles in serious accidents, they can break bones, suffer paralysis, or experience traumatic head injuries. All these injuries can have potentially life-long ramifications. These injuries can also result in high medical bills and lost wages, along with pain, suffering, emotional distress, loss of enjoyment of life, and loss of spousal companionship or support.

However, you have legal options available. An Anniston bicycle accident lawyer can review those legal options with you and help you determine whether you have a viable case. Call a passionate attorney today to set up a free consultation.

pages.title: Anniston Car Accident Lawyer | Recoverable Damages
pages.description: If you have been injured in a car accident, consult a qualified Anniston car accident lawyer that could pursue a positive outcome for you.
pages.content_md:
Car accidents remain a significant problem in Alabama, causing over 1,500 fatalities in 2017. If you have suffered an injury in a car accident in Anniston, there may be a legal remedy for your injuries and damages.

Because the law surrounding car accidents in Anniston are complex, you may want to speak with an Anniston car accident lawyer who could examine the specific circumstances surrounding your case and inform you of any legal options that may be available to you. Because the time frame under Anniston law in which someone may file a car accident claim is relatively short, it is usually wise to contact a capable car accident attorney with experience and knowledge in litigating these types of cases as soon as possible after an accident.

Under Section 32-7-5 of the Alabama Motor Vehicle and Traffic Code, any car accident in Alabama must be reported to authorities if it caused death, personal injury, or property damages in excess of $500, or if involved an uninsured motorist. Furthermore, the parties involved in the accident must submit this report within 30 days of the incident.

Under Anniston law, a person can be held responsible for the damages in a car accident if they caused the car or SUV accident because of their careless or reckless behavior. Common examples of careless or reckless behavior in Anniston car accident cases include speeding, driving while texting or otherwise distracted, or ignoring a traffic light or stop sign at an intersection.

If the reckless or careless behavior of another driver causes an accident, then any injured victims of their actions may have legal options to recover those damages. In general, plaintiffs in a car accident will have two years from the date of the accident to file a lawsuit in an Anniston court for any property damage or personal injuries resulting from the accident.

A car accident victim can typically recover any property damage under Anniston law, including damage to the vehicle itself and loss of future value of the car. Property damage can also include other personal items, depending on the contents inside of the car and the severity of the car crash.

Anniston personal injury law also allows a car accident victim to pursue compensation for a variety of personal damages. These can include economic damages�such as any medical bills or compensation for lost wages because of missed work�and non-economic damages, which are not as easily measurable. Common types of non-economic damages sought include damages for pain and suffering and punitive damages, which are typically damages awarded to punish a bad car driver. A qualified�Anniston car accident lawyer could help individuals pursue the damages that they are owed.

Usually, the driver or drivers whose reckless actions cause a car accident will be the ones held legally responsible for its damages such as medical bills, car repair costs, or lost wages. However, the types of damages and the amount of responsibility can depend on a varying number of factors�as can your own ability to hold the responsible parties liable in court.

To receive compensation, you may need a lawyer who understands car accidents and has experience in litigating these personal injury cases in Anniston, Alabama. If you are involved in a car accident, then contact an Anniston car accident lawyer for assistance today.

pages.title: Anniston Front-End Car Accident Lawyer | Car Collisions and Wrecks
pages.description: If you or a loved one has sustained damages from a front-end auto wreck, contact an Anniston front-end car accident lawyer for help with filing a claim.
pages.content_md:
Head-on collisions, also called front-end accidents, are considered somewhat rare compared to other types of automobile crashes. When they do occur, though, they are responsible for a higher rate of fatal injuries than most other crashes. In many cases, this is because the vehicles involved are both traveling at highway speeds, which means the ensuing impact between them is extreme.

If you or someone you love suffered injuries from a car accident, make sure you are getting the legal advice you need from a skilled car accident attorney. An experienced Anniston front-end car accident lawyer understands that irresponsible driving causes accidents and could help you pursue compensation after yours.

Injuries that result from head-on collisions can incur exorbitant medical bills. For those who cannot return to work because of their injuries, the subsequent loss of income may compound this situation. Those who experience financial loss from their accident may be eligible for compensation for current and future expenses.

If an injured party suspects their accident was caused by the carelessness or recklessness of another party, a lawsuit should be considered. In addition, for those who filed a claim with the other driver�s insurance company and have not received payment yet or cannot agree on a settlement, a lawsuit might be an appropriate next step. A front-end collision lawyer in Anniston could negotiate with insurance companies to help the process go more smoothly or advise someone when it is time to sue.

If an Anniston front-end car accident lawyer brings a case to trial, they must present evidence to demonstrate the extent of a person�s injuries and prove who was at fault. �The judge or jury then determines the percentage of responsibility for all the parties involved in the accident.

For example, after a front-end car accident, an injured driver could be faced with $30,000 in damages between medical bills, surgery costs, and lost wages. However, if the court determines that the plaintiff was texting while driving right before the accident and is therefore 100 percent at fault for the accident, that plaintiff would be barred from collecting any monetary damages from the defendant.

A plaintiff in Anniston may be barred from collecting damages if their assigned percentage of fault is higher than that of the defendant. However, if the plaintiff is between one and 50 percent at fault, they may recover a portion of damages equivalent to their total damage award less the percentage of fault they themselves bore.

A front-end car accident often results in tragic, life-changing consequences. Protect yourself by seeking out an advocate with the knowledge and resources that could get you and your family the compensation needed to get back on your feet. To start pursuing the justice you deserve, call a dedicated Anniston front-end car accident lawyer today.

pages.content_md:
The National Safety Council reports that one in five accidents happen in parking lots, with cell phone use being the most common cause. Unfortunately, most people do not think the rules of the road apply to parking lots, and this leads to a false sense of security.

If you were injured recently in a parking lot accident, a practiced car crash attorney could be of assistance. An Anniston parking lot accident lawyer could evaluate the details of your accident and provide information on available options.

The scary truth is that each year 60,000 people are injured in parking lot crashes, and more than 500 die from these injuries. In addition to cell phone use, parking lots offer other uniquely dangerous circumstances that are made even more treacherous by inattentive driving, including:

- Ambiguous crosswalks and pedestrian areas
- Children playing in the lot
- Limited visibility and high congestion
- Poor judgment backing in/out of parking spaces
- Vehicles parked in prohibited areas

There are three main types of parking lot accident liability,

- One-Vehicle Collisions
- Two-Vehicle Collisions
- Pedestrian Collisions

When a moving vehicle hits a stationary object like a sign or median, it may appear that the driver is at fault for the collision. However, there are often other factors at play. For example, a parking lot accident lawyer in Anniston could investigate the scene of the accident to determine if the parking lot owner was negligent in their duty to maintain their property and keep it free of hazards.

When two moving vehicles hit each other, it may be hard to determine who is liable without an investigation initiated by a car accident attorney. An Anniston parking lot accident lawyer could determine what factors may be involved in the cause of a potential client�s accident and the condition of the parking lot at the time the accident occurred.

However, when one moving vehicle hits a stationary vehicle, fault may be assigned to the driver of the moving vehicle unless the other car was parked illegally or inappropriately.

As with any pedestrian accident, when a vehicle hits a person or child in a parking lot, the resulting injuries can be quite serious and often fatal. Parking lots often leave motorists with limited visibility, and pedestrians in parking lots are often unclear on their own rights and obligations as well. Although everyone must exercise extreme caution in a parking lot, pedestrians do have rights within crosswalks, and vehicles have the right of way almost everywhere else.

When planning on filing a lawsuit, it may be important to keep in mind that most states have time limits, or statues of limitations, that must be adhered to. Alabama Code � 6-32-38 explains that those who suffer injuries resulting from an accident have up to two years to file a claim.

However, it is not uncommon for those who are injured in a car accident to discover that injuries which at first seemed minor developed into more serious complications a year later. Additionally, statutes of limitations can vary depending on the circumstances. For example, claims against government agencies can have shorter time limits.

Those who are injured in a parking lot accident should contact an Anniston parking lot accident lawyer as soon as possible. Parking lot attorneys could assist a potential client with any applicable statutes of limitations to avoid missing the opportunity to file a claim.

Whether you are facing the complications of a minor fender bender, the consequences of a hit and run, or devastating injuries, our parking lot accident attorneys could hear the details of your case and provide the knowledge and resources to bring you the best possible outcome.

Do not allow yourself or your family to remain vulnerable to complicated accident laws and inadequate settlements. An Anniston parking lot accident lawyer could begin to build your case today. To hear what compensation you may be entitled to, contact an attorney today.

pages.title: Anniston Rear-End Car Accident Lawyer | Bumper-to-Bumper Collisions

pages.content_md:
According to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, there were approximately 1,038 traffic fatalities in Alabama in 2016. That equates to an increase of 150 traffic fatalities from the previous year. Speeding and driving too fast for the road conditions were the number one cause for these fatalities, both of which also often cause rear-end collisions as well.

Rear-end accidents are often thought of as fender benders. In fact, those involved in this type of accident may walk away uninjured. However, rear-end collisions are not limited to two vehicles of the same size, and often involve a combination of trucks, motorcycles, SUVs and even golf carts.

Although many people imagine that such crashes involve a vehicle stopped at a stop sign getting bumped by the car behind them, the truth is that a rear-end collision can happen when both vehicles are traveling at highway speeds. When the front end of a car strikes the back tire of a motorcycle, for example, the consequences can be disastrous.

An Anniston rear-end car accident lawyer could assist you if you suffer injury and loss from a car accident. With distracted driving on the rise, experienced car accident attorneys know what to look for to determine liability for your case.

As the name suggests, a rear-end collision occurs when one vehicle hits another from behind. Although it is commonly assumed that the driver who hits another from behind is at fault, this may not necessarily be the case. There are many situations that can cause this type of accident, including:

- ��������Poor weather conditions
- ��������Distracted or drunk driving
- ��������Falling asleep behind the wheel
- ��������Tailgating
- ��������Sudden turns or stops
- ��������Speeding

Alabama is a pure contributory negligence state which means that any degree of liability placed on the Plaintiff will defeat their entitlement to damages. Again, any degree of liability (no matter how slight) placed on the injured plaintiff by a jury will negate any award for damages. Alabama is unique in that sense. Only three other states have such a law. For more insight into this law, an individual should get in contact with an Anniston rear-end car accident lawyer.

- Exchange information � Make sure to acquire both the contact and insurance information for the other driver

A serious injury could change your life forever, and seasoned accident lawyers understand how susceptible victims of car accidents may be to such injuries. If you were injured in a rear-end car accident in Georgia, you may be wondering where to turn next.

Do not leave your future in inexperienced hands. An Anniston rear-end car accident lawyer could thoroughly investigate your collision to determine cause and communicate with police, insurance inspectors, and doctors to help acquire the necessary evidence to prove liability. pages.title: Anniston Side-Impact Car Accident Lawyer | T-Bone Collisions
pages.description: If you have been involved in a T-bone collision, call an Anniston side-impact car accident lawyer for help with filing a compensation claim.
pages.content_md:
Side-impact car accidents take most victims by surprise, and what may have started out as a regular day could quickly turn into a life-altering event for both the injured party and their families. An experienced Anniston side-impact car accident lawyer understands the challenges that the victims of car accidents face and, with knowledge of Alabama�s accident and liability laws, could evaluate the circumstances of your accident and help you build a strong case for compensation. Contact an�accomplished car crash attorney today.

In many respects, side-impact car accidents may be considerably more dangerous than other types of collisions, as the initial impact can cause the vehicle to spin, roll, or collide with other cars or objects. The injuries caused by these types of accidents are devastating and often include:

- Bone fractures
- Traumatic Brain Injuries
- Injuries to the neck and spine
- Lung punctures
- Severe lacerations

A side-impact car accident occurs when one vehicle collides with the side of another vehicle. This type of accident can happen in three distinct ways. Same-direction sideswipes occur when two vehicles are traveling alongside of each other. One vehicle fails to notice the other and makes an improper turn or lane change.

Opposite-direction sideswipes occur when two vehicles are traveling in opposite directions. As the vehicles approach each other, one driver may fail to stay in their lane and strike the other. Sideswipes can also occur in areas where the road is too narrow for two vehicles to pass at once. T-bone accidents, also called right-angle collisions, often occur at an intersection. Typically, one driver fails to stop and is hit on the left or right side by the front end of an oncoming vehicle.

In most�personal injury cases, the plaintiff has the right to pursue compensation for damages that directly result in financial loss. These types of damages�also known as economic damages�can include vehicle repair, medical bills, hospital charges, physical therapy costs, and lost wages. An Anniston side-impact car accident lawyer in could keep track of a client�s finical losses and make allowances for future expenses as well.

Conversely, non-economic losses may not be directly related to out-of-pocket expenses, but they involve injuries that have cost the plaintiff their former quality of life. Chronic pain and mental anguish are two examples of non-economic damages.

Families who lose a loved one in an accident, due to the carelessness of another, may be eligible for wrongful death compensation for related medical bills, funeral expenses, and burial costs. Dependents can seek compensation for income the deceased would have earned had they survived.

Finally, according to Alabama Code � 6-11-20, punitive damages are a monetary punishment for the defendant. They are only awarded in car accident cases not involving wrongful death where it is proven by clear and convincing evidence that the defendant consciously or deliberately engaged in oppression, fraud, wantonness, or malice with regard to the plaintiff.

If you suffer from injuries or the loss of a loved one from a side-impact car accident, contact an Anniston side-impact car accident lawyer immediately. An attorney�could gather necessary evidence, utilize accident witnesses, and evaluate your personal situation to get you the compensation you deserve. Call today to get started on your case.

pages.content_md:
The consequences of a catastrophic injury can be long-lasting and keep you from being able to gain employment. Furthermore, illnesses and conditions stemming from these injuries can create permanent disability. Common catastrophic injuries may involve damage to the head, brain, spinal cord, neck, or limbs, including severe burns and accidental amputation.

According to reports by the United States Centers for Disease Control (CDC), about 2.8 million hospital stays or emergency room visits occur each year due to catastrophic injuries. Cases involving catastrophic injuries aim to get compensation for injured persons suffering from these lifelong disabilities.

If you or a loved one suffered a catastrophic injury, you should consult with an Anniston catastrophic injury lawyer who could work diligently to represent your best interests. Sometimes a catastrophic injury claim is settled too quickly, and the injured party accepts an inadequate settlement that does not meet their growing financial challenges and needs. pages.title: Anniston Burn Injury Lawyer | Pursuing Damages for Burn Injuries
pages.description: If you have been injured in a serious burn accident, a dedicated Anniston burn injury lawyer could help you recover the damages you deserve.
pages.content_md:
Burn injuries can be excruciating, and a burn victim�s most important priority immediately after an accident should be recovery. However, concerns about paying medical bills related to burn care treatment can hinder and slow the recovery process. In addition, burn injury victims may not be able to return to work for quite some time and may be worried about lost wages.

If your accident was caused by the negligent actions of another party, you may be able to pursue compensation for present and future financial losses. A skilled Anniston burn injury lawyer could help your family hold the responsible party accountable by making a claim for compensation. Contact a qualified personal injury attorney today for help with the recovery process.

Roughly 450,000 burn injuries in the United States require emergency room or hospital treatment each year, and that figure does not include all the burn injuries that are not immediately treated or receive treatment in private doctor offices. About 40,000 burns each year are serious enough to require hospitalization or treatment in a residential burn treatment facility.

Even when a burn is minor, the effects can be long-lasting and complications could arise later. For this reason, it may be important for anyone who has suffered a burn injury due to another party’s negligence to consult with a skilled Anniston burn injury lawyer.

Fires are the most common cause of burn injuries in Anniston and are often fatal. More than 3,000 people die each year from fires and burns, whether they occur in residences, vehicles, or other locations.

Burn injuries caused by direct contact with fire or flames account for almost half of all burn injuries. Scalding injuries are the next most common type of burn and account for a third of all burns.

Other less common causes of burns are explosions, chemical burns, and electrical burns. Each of these represents less than ten percent of all types of burns, according to the American Burn Association.

Various different parties could potentially bear liability for causing a burn injury. Some common parties that may be held responsible in civil court for burn injuries include but are not limited to:

- Employers overseeing unsafe work environments that give rise to fires, chemical burns, or explosions
- Vehicle manufacturers whose vehicles are likely to catch fire due to a defect
- Other drivers on the road who cause an accident or commercial driver parent companies whose drivers caused accidents or vehicle fires
- Municipal entities responsible for maintaining safe roadways
- Premises owners when a fire occurred on someone else’s property
- Contractors responsible for electrical safety and installation
- Product manufacturers and designers whose products, especially electric products, tend to spark or catch fire

If through their own negligence, any of these parties cause someone to suffer a burn injury, that injured person could have grounds to file suit against them for damages. An Anniston�burn injury lawyer could provide further assistance and advice to any burn victim in Alabama who wants to see what legal options may be available to them.

Regardless of the cause or severity of your burn injury, you may need experienced legal help to achieve a positive resolution to any civil case you elect to pursue. An experienced Anniston burn injury lawyer could deal with the financial and administrative matters of your personal injury claim while you focus on your recovery.

Holding the responsible party accountable for causing your burn may not only be necessary to alleviate your financial stress�it can also be an empowering part of the healing process for burn victims. Talk to us today to see what your options may be.

pages.title: Anniston Paralysis Injury Lawyer | Serious Bodily Injury Claims
pages.description: If you or a loved one have been injured in a negligent accident causing paralysis, get in touch with an Anniston paralysis lawyer today.
pages.content_md:
Paralysis is one of the more expensive and harmful injuries a person can suffer, often affecting every aspect of a victim�s life. A person who becomes paralyzed after an accident may be required to make major adjustments to their employment, housing, transportation, long-term medical needs, and family relationships.

If you or your loved one suffered paralysis after an accident caused by the negligence of another party, you may need assistance from an Anniston paralysis injury lawyer. A dedicated injury attorney could help you seek the compensation you need to move forward with your health and lifestyle changes.

Almost any accident could theoretically result in paralysis or spinal injury, which means almost any scenario could result in grounds for an injury lawsuit and the need for help from an Anniston paralysis injury attorney. Some of the most common causes of paralysis in Anniston include but are not limited to:

- Motor vehicle accidents
- Sports injuries
- Diving, bicycling, horseback riding, and other recreational accidents
- Falls from great heights and or from slipping
- Penetrating wounds, gunshot injuries, and domestic violence
- Stroke, multiple sclerosis, and infection

Paralysis is a central nervous system dysfunction involving the loss of movement in one or more limbs or, in certain cases, the face and/or vocal cords. Roughly 5.6 million people in the United States experience some form of paralysis.

Paralysis is almost always permanent and is disabling by nature. Care for those suffering from paralysis is typically expensive, involving steep costs related to:

- Hospitalization and surgery
- Physical therapy
- Assistive medical devices such as wheelchairs
- Medications
- Therapy for the emotional aspects of paralysis
- Adaptation of the individual’s home and vehicle
- Long-term nursing care

Often, a paralyzed individual is unable to return to work, either at all or in the same capacity. The Christopher and Dana Reeves Foundation found nearly 30 percent of paralyzed individuals earn less than $15,000 per year, with about 40 percent reporting they were unable to work at all. In other situations, a paralyzed individual�s family member must quit or take leave from their job to provide the victim around-the-clock care and transportation to and from their medical appointments.

While no amount of money can restore a paralysis victim’s health, compensation through a personal injury award may help families dealing with the unexpected costs that a paralysis injury may produce. Furthermore, paralysis victims may be eligible for compensation for non-monetary losses, such as loss of enjoyment in their life, loss of their ability to enjoy intimate relationships, and their pain and suffering or mental anguish.

Paralyzed individuals may also be eligible for punitive damages aimed at punishing the wrongdoing party who caused the accident. In Alabama, obtaining punitive damages requires that the victim establish the defendant’s conduct was “wanton,” or so reckless that the defendant should have known their conduct could risk the lives and safety of others.

Punitive damages in Alabama for physical injuries such as paralysis are capped at $1.5 million or three times the amount of compensatory damages, whichever is greater. To find out what damages may be possible in their individual case, potential plaintiffs individuals could contact a paralysis injury lawyer in Anniston for professional advice on the matter.

No matter the cause or extent of your paralysis, an experienced Anniston paralysis lawyer could work on your behalf to help you and your family pursue the compensation you deserve following a devastating accident. In the process, your dedicated attorney could help you and your family evaluate your injuries and losses and determine the amount of recoverable damages available to you. Call today to schedule a consultation and get help with the process of financial and medical recovery.

pages.title: Anniston Spinal Cord Injury Lawyer | Serious Injury Liability
pages.description: If you or a loved one have suffered an accident causing a spinal cord injury, you have the right to damages. Speak to an Anniston spinal cord injury lawyer.
pages.content_md:
Spinal cord injuries are almost always disabling and life-changing, even when the injured person recovers to some degree. If you or a loved one suffered a spinal cord injury, you may need the help of an Anniston spinal cord injury lawyer to effectively pursue compensation from the responsible party on your behalf.

While no compensation can fully amend the life-changing circumstances surrounding a spinal cord injury, a damage award could help you pay your medical expenses associated with that injury. This could range from the cost of surgeries and intensive care stays to the cost of renovating a house or a vehicle for a disabled individual. Contact a compassionate injury attorney for assistance starting your claim.

There are about 1.4 million spinal cord injuries in the U.S. each year, costing the healthcare industry upwards of $40 billion each year. Spinal cord injuries can result from almost any type of accident, especially those that involve injuries to the back, neck, or head. Some of the most common causes of spinal cord injuries in Anniston include but are not limited to:

- Motor vehicle accidents
- Domestic violence, assaults, and gunshot wounds
- Strain from physical labor
- Recreational or sports injuries
- Falling accidents

In a successful spinal cord injury lawsuit, compensation for damages would come from the responsible parties� insurances. Some parties who could bear responsibility for causing or contributing to a spinal cord injury include:

- Premises owners of the property on which the injury took place
- Drivers or commercial companies involved in motor vehicle accidents
- Employers in the case of workplace accidents
- Schools, teams, or sports and recreation facilities
- Product manufacturers whose defects contributed to the accident

In certain cases, an individual suffering a spinal cord injury could obtain punitive damages, which are aimed at punishing the wrongdoing party for their negligence and egregious conduct. Alabama limits punitive damages to $1.5 million per physical injury case or three times the amount of compensatory damages, whichever amount is greater.

However, the punitive damage cap does not apply to the victim’s compensatory damages. Victims may seek damages for their economic damages like lost wages, medical bills, and future medical needs, as well as non-economic losses such as the loss of enjoyment in life or intimate relationships. An Anniston spinal cord injury attorney could help individuals identify their compensable damages and formulate a thorough settlement demand to cover them all.

In Anniston, accident victims who are partially responsible for their own injuries may be barred from seeking compensation from the other responsible party, even if the victim is only a small percentage at fault. As a result, it is common for defendants and their legal teams to claim the plaintiff in a spinal cord injury suit shares responsibility for causing the accident. This possibility underscores the potential importance of having help from a skilled spinal cord injury lawyer in Anniston to rebut claims of contributory negligence.

No matter the cause of your spinal cord injury or the severity of the disability you suffer, an experienced spinal cord injury lawyer in Anniston could work with you to seek the compensation you may be entitled to. Obtaining financial recovery could help pay medical bills and other expenses, hold the responsible party accountable for their negligence, and hopefully deter future wrongdoing on their part. Call now to find out about your legal options.

pages.title: Anniston Traumatic Brain Injury Lawyer | TBI Care Compensation
pages.description: If you or a loved one have suffered a traumatic brain injury, get in touch with an Anniston traumatic brain injury lawyer right away.
pages.content_md:
Traumatic brain injuries (TBIs) are unfortunately very common. According to data from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the rate of traumatic brain injuries in the U.S. has climbed in the past decade, reaching a rate of 823.7 per 100,000 in 2010. Unfortunately, it is often not possible for individuals suffering from traumatic brain injuries to reach their greatest potential recovery without the funds to pay for necessary post-injury care. Even when a victim receives basic treatment at a hospital, the road to recovery after leaving the hospital may require years of continued care, which many families of traumatic brain injury victims struggle to afford.

Fortunately, assistance is available in the form of a personal injury attorney. If you or a loved one suffered a traumatic brain injury due to another party’s negligence, a skilled Anniston traumatic brain injury lawyer could help you and your family seek compensation to cover the costs of medical care, rehabilitation, lost wages, and more.

Depending on the circumstances, many accidents have the potential to result in a traumatic brain injury. These can range from everyday scenarios to high-risk situations. Some of the most common causes of traumatic brain injuries in Anniston include but are not limited to:

- Motor vehicle accidents
- Falls from great heights
- Being hit with a falling or flying object
- Assaults and domestic violence
- Gunshot wounds and other penetrating injuries
- Sports and recreational injuries
- Fainting

Falls are by far the most common cause of traumatic brain injuries for elderly persons and children, while young people and middle-aged adults most typically experience traumatic brain injuries from motor vehicle accidents, assaults, and being struck by objects. Regardless of the age group a TBI victim falls into, though, an Anniston traumatic brain injury attorney could help them and their family seek compensation for their injuries if someone else is to blame for causing them.

Courts in Anniston may award both economic and non-economic damages to traumatic brain injury victims. Economic damages include objectively measurable costs like medical bills and lost wages, while non-economic damages are intangible losses such as pain and suffering and the loss of enjoyment in life.

Under certain circumstances, punitive damages may be awarded as well. These aim to punish the negligent party who caused the traumatic brain injury. Punitive damages in Alabama are capped at the greater of $1.5 million or three times the compensatory damages.

It is common for people suffering from a traumatic brain injury to suffer all these types of losses, and it may only be fair for these victims to seek some compensation from the negligent party. A dedicated traumatic brain injury lawyer in Anniston could help victims do just that.

Whether you only need compensation for short-term care or also anticipate the need for long-term medical care, an Anniston traumatic brain injury lawyer could help your family during this difficult time. Depending on the circumstances that led to your injury, you may be eligible for damages for both monetary and non-monetary damages. To begin seeking the compensation you need from the party responsible for your accident, call today to schedule a consultation.

pages.title: Anniston Dangerous Drugs Lawyer | Harmful Medication
pages.description: If you or a loved one has suffered from a serious side effect due to medication, you may be entitled to compensation. Call an Anniston dangerous drugs lawyer today to see how an attorney could help you recover the damages you deserve.
pages.content_md:
People typically visit healthcare providers and take prescription drugs in order to feel better and recover from a medical condition. However, when drugs are defective, they could cause more harm than good.

Drugs can be dangerous in a variety of ways. In some instances, they are improperly manufactured or distributed. For example, the drug manufacturer may fail to account for drug interactions or other side effects. In other instances, the warning labels on drug containers may be missing or are insufficient to properly warn patients of harmful side effects.

If you or a loved one sustained injuries as a result of a dangerous or defective drug, you may be able to file a claim against the drug manufacturer or distributor. An Anniston dangerous drugs lawyer can review your case with you and explore all your available legal options. Call today to schedule a consultation with an accomplished personal injury attorney.

The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is constantly updating its recall list of dangerous drugs. Some drugs are recalled because they cause very serious side effects and other injuries. Some examples of recalled drugs include:

- Vioxx
- Paxil
- Zoloft
- Ephedra
- Accutane
- Fen-Phen

These drugs are used for a variety of purposes and to treat a variety of conditions, ranging from obesity to acne.

Dangerous drugs on the market can cause serious side effects and interactions with other drugs that a patient may be taking. Dangerous side effects associated with problem drugs include renal failure, infections, heart disease, strokes, cancer, and psychological problems, to name a few. As soon as someone notices an adverse side effect, they should see a doctor and then consider contacting a knowledgeable Anniston dangerous drugs lawyer that could help them begin building their claim.

Drug companies are required to run their drugs through the necessary tests. They have a duty to make sure that their drugs are safe for public consumption. When they fail to do this and serious injuries result, the injured patient may be able to file a claim or lawsuit against the offending party.

In order to prevail in such a claim or lawsuit, the injured patient must prove that the drug company behaved unreasonably, such as by failing to undertake the necessary protocols. The injured patient must also show that the drug company�s negligence directly resulted in their injuries and damages. This can be difficult to prove without the assistance of an expert healthcare provider, such as a doctor, pharmacist, pharmacologist, or drug researcher. An experienced dangerous drugs lawyer in Anniston could help an injured person prove liability.

If the patient dies as a result of exposure to a dangerous drug, then their relatives may be able to open an estate on their behalf. After appointing a personal representative, the decedent�s estate may be able to pursue monetary compensation from the negligent drug company.

Dangerous drugs have the potential to cause irreversible side effects and even death. Elderly patients are often the most vulnerable to dangerous drugs. They are reliant on the drug companies and their healthcare providers to give them the medication they need to get better.

Drug companies have strong legal representation on their side. If you or a loved one was injured due to a dangerous drug, an Anniston dangerous drugs lawyer can take on the insurance company and pursue compensation on your behalf.

pages.title: Anniston Defective Products Lawyer | Product Liability
pages.description: If you were using a product correctly and it caused you harm, you may be entitled to compensation. Speak with a seasoned Anniston defective products lawyer who could help you file a claim to recover damages.
pages.content_md:
Consumers rely on product manufacturers and distributors to supply them with reliable and safe products. When products malfunction and cause injuries, individuals can hold these manufacturers and distributors accountable for their actions or inactions.

Defective products can break, shatter, electrocute, and malfunction in other ways that lead to serious injuries. Those injuries may include cuts, bruises, broken bones, head injuries (TBI�s), and burns.

If you sustained a serious injury as a result of a defective product, you may have a right to monetary compensation. An Anniston defective products lawyer can examine your potential bases of recovery and determine whether you have a viable claim or lawsuit against a product manufacturer or distributor. Call a dedicated personal injury attorney today to schedule a consultation.

Product manufacturers are the companies or entities that make certain goods and products. Distributors sell these products to consumers and include department stores and other retailers who are in the business of selling merchandise.

Product manufacturers have a duty to ensure that their products are safe when they leave their hands. This means that the product must be reasonably safe to operate and does not contain any serious defects. Product distributors, including stores, also have a duty to ensure the product is safe when it comes to them and when it leaves their hands and goes to the consumer.

Defective products are more common than many people think and can range from refrigerators to motor vehicle parts. Some common examples include:

� Household appliances

� Motor vehicle parts

� Infant cribs and car seats

� Construction equipment

� Household furniture

� Medication

� Portable heaters and air conditioning units

� Electric blankets

When product manufacturers are careless about the condition of their products � or fail to ensure their products are safe � serious accidents and injuries can result. If an injured consumer can prove that a product manufacturer or distributor failed to make or sell a reasonably safe product, they may be negligent. The injured consumer must also be able to prove that the injuries and damages sustained would not have occurred but for the defective product. A well-trained defective products lawyer could help with establishing fault.

The law of strict liability can impose sanctions on a product manufacturer or distributor without regard to fault. For example, if a product was not manufactured or designed properly � or lacked adequate warnings � the manufacturer or distributor may be responsible if they placed the defective product on the market.

Defective products that cause injury are a serious concern. If a product explodes or catches on fire, it can even kill the consumer. When that happens, the decedent�s surviving family members may be able to open an estate and pursue monetary compensation that way.

Even if a defective product only causes injuries, the injured consumer may still be eligible to recover the costs associated with their medical treatment, physical therapy, and lost wages. pages.title: Anniston Dog Bite Lawyer | Damages and Compensation
pages.description: Dogs can make great pets, but that does not mean they are not prone to attack people. If you have been attacked by a dog, contact an Anniston dog bite lawyer today.
pages.content_md:
Dogs are often lauded as a man�s best friend. However, this saying does not mean they are perfect, and dog attacks and bites could leave someone injured and traumatized.

Victims of dog attacks may be embarrassed or dealing with a life-altering trauma that they would rather forget. Unfortunately, many dog attacks go unreported or are mistreated, which could cause more problems down the line. However, if you are injured by a dog bite, you may be eligible to receive medical and legal remedies.

An experienced Anniston dog bite lawyer could be fully equipped and prepared to deal with dog bite cases and represent your rights. If you or a loved one have recently suffered injury from a dog attack, contact a team of personal injury attorneys today so that they may represent you.

According to Alabama�s statute on dog bites, a dog owner�s liability for a dog attack must be proven by the victim filing suit against them. In other words, the plaintiff must demonstrate that the animal was:

- Vicious and/or dangerous
- In the possession of a negligent owner who did not properly control them with a leash, fence, or chain
- Not provoked by the plaintiff

Any other dangerous or potentially injurious behavior demonstrated by the dog may also be taken into account.

Furthermore, in order to be held liable for negligence, a dog owner must understand their dog lacked reasonable care or is a threat to the public and still fail to act in a reasonable way that would prevent their dog from harming someone else.

It is important to understand what can happen if a dog bite is left ignored or untreated, and accordingly how important it may be. Some common possible injuries include:

- Skin, muscle, and bone punctures
- Infections
- Broken bones
- Rabies
- Amputation (in extreme cases)
- Mental and emotional trauma

If someone has experienced any of these symptoms after suffering a dog bite, they should seek medical attention and call an Anniston dog bite attorney today.

Recent studies have shown that small children are most likely to get bitten by dogs and men generally experience more dog bites in their lifetimes than women. In the same vein, a dog that serves as a house pet is actually more likely to bite its owners than a stray dog would be.

According to Statista, over 80 million dogs live as pets all across the United States. Over 4.5 million dog bites happen each year, but only around 800,000 victims seek actual medical attention after these attacks. Do not let only the most severe cases�be�reported�you may be entitled to compensation, regardless of the severity of the attack you experience.

If you reside in the Anniston area and were the victim of any sort of dog bite, an Anniston dog bite lawyer may be able to help. Pick up the phone and give us a call for a comprehensive consultation.

pages.title: Anniston Medical Malpractice Lawyer | Medical Error Claims

pages.content_md:
The public often trusts doctors to accurately diagnose disorders or illnesses and prescribe a course of treatment that will alleviate their problem as efficiently as possible. However, even with years of education and training, physicians are not infallible. When a physician makes a mistake that causes harm to a patient, they may fall below the standard of care and be found guilty of medical malpractice.

According to the National Practitioner Data Bank, over 600,000 people filed reports of medical malpractice across the U.S. over the last decade. If you believe you too have suffered from a healthcare provider�s error, an Anniston medical malpractice lawyer could help you pursue the justice you deserve. Get in touch with a trusted personal injury attorney today to get started reviewing your circumstances and filing a claim for financial recovery.

Individuals who are victims of medical malpractice may choose to file suit for compensation, citing the need to recover the financial and emotional damages caused by the medical malpractice injury. These damages can include:

- Lost wages
- Future reduction in the ability to work
- Additional medical costs
- Cost of assistive technology such as wheelchairs
- Emotional distress

In addition to potentially obtaining financial compensation, many people find that holding physicians or other responsible parties is a strong motivating factor to file suit. Regardless of a client�s personal motivations, an�Anniston medical malpractice lawyer could help them take stock of their damages and explore the legal options for recovery available to them.

For a physician to be guilty of medical malpractice, they must make a medical decision that falls below the reasonable standard of care for their field. This is defined by The Alabama Medical Liability Act as a �level of such reasonable care, skill and diligence as other similarly situated health care providers in the same general line of practice.�

This standard is based on medical practitioners across the country, not just those in Alabama. In other words, this means a physician must always treat their patients with a similar level of care as that which would be used by other doctors in the same line of practice anywhere else in the United States.

If a doctor fails to meet this standard of care and causes an injury to a patient, they could be guilty of medical malpractice. This area of the law can be somewhat complex, but a seasoned medical malpractice lawyer in Anniston could help a potential claimant understand the nuances.

Individuals may also recover compensation through proof of battery or assault in some medical injury cases. This may occur when a surgeon fails to properly gain consent for the procedure performed. For example, if a surgeon and patient agree to operate on the patient�s ear and the surgeon ends up operating on the patient�s nose as well, they may be found guilty of battery. Anniston medical malpractice attorneys could determine whether a case falls under an alternative form of recovery.

If you believe that you were a victim of medical malpractice, working with an Anniston medical malpractice lawyer may be your best option going forward. A practiced attorney could help you understand the detailed conditions of medical malpractice laws and assess your situation. Legal professionals could help you pursue the financial compensation to which you may be entitled. Call today to schedule an initial consultation.

pages.title: Anniston Birth Injury Lawyer | Birthing Accident Claims

pages.content_md:
Most parents expect to have healthy babies, especially when no problems were diagnosed during pregnancy. However, if your baby does suffer harm during birth because of a medical provider’s negligence, the consequences can be devastating. If you have unexpectedly high medical bills and experience emotional pain and suffering as a result of such maltreatment, it could be time to file a personal injury lawsuit.

Fortunately, an Anniston birth injury lawyer could help you and your family deal with financial concerns resulting from your baby’s birth injury. While no amount of compensation can rectify the situation, a compassionate personal injury attorney could work with you to alleviate some of the financial burden of your child’s current and future health needs.

There are several different birth injuries a child may suffer prior to, during, or just after their birth, all of which by definition could have been prevented with proper care. Some common types of birth injuries include:

- Injuries to the shoulder and nerves in the baby’s arms and hands, a condition known as shoulder dystocia
- Facial paralysis or nerve problems which may be temporary or long-term
- Bruises, contusions, infections, and other injuries from assistive delivery techniques such as forceps or vacuum extractions
- Bone and skull fractures
- Cerebral palsy
- Brain damage due to lack of oxygen

Any of these injuries can cause serious and sometimes permanent damage to a child�s health and well-being. As such, they may be grounds for a civil suit that a qualified birth injury lawyer in Anniston could help an injured child�s parents file.

For personal injury cases, Alabama generally maintains a statute of limitations of two years from the date the injury. Because birth injuries may not be discovered right away, though, the time limit in these cases is actually two years from the date of injury�typically the date of birth�or, if the two-year time limit passes, six months from the date the injury is discovered.

This extension for delayed discovery of birth injuries applies as long as the discovery is not more than four years from the date of injury, if the child is older than four years old. If a child�s birth is discovered prior to their fourth birthday, any birth injury lawsuit must be filed before the child’s eighth birthday.

In practice, this means plaintiffs may need to establish to the court that they did not learn of the birth injury in time to meet the two-year guideline. Because of the complex time limit rules, it is advisable to consult with an Anniston birth injury lawyer as soon as possible if parents suspect a possible birth injury.

Contributory negligence becomes a factor in Anniston birth injury cases when an injured party shares part of the blame in creating their own injuries. Some states allow claimants who are partially at fault to recover some compensation from the other party, but Alabama does not. Under Alabama State law, claimants who are partially responsible for their own injuries may have their recovery barred altogether, no matter how small of a percentage of fault is attributable to them.

In birth injury cases, any degree of contributory negligence stems from the mother’s potential negligence, since the child involved could not have contributed to their own injury at or prior to birth. It is not uncommon for the defense team representing a medical provider or hospital to claim the mother was negligent herself by, for example, failing to comply with prenatal recommendations.

Regardless of the type or severity of your child�s birth injury, an Anniston birth injury lawyer could help you and your family deal with the physical, emotional, and financial consequences. With a seasoned attorney�s help, you could argue against the defendant�s potential claim of contributory negligence and take advantage of any legal options available to you. Under contributory negligence, an accident victim is often not entitled to any monetary recovery if they contributed to their accident in any way. This is true even if they contributed as little as one percent to the accident.

Contributory negligence applies just as much to injured motorcycle operators as it does to injured passengers. For example, if an injured passenger grabs the handlebars and causes or contributes to the accident, then they may not be entitled to recover any money damages.

As a Anniston motorcycle accident lawyer knows, the insurance companies know and understand the contributory negligence doctrine. If they suspect the accident victim did something to cause or contribute to the accident, they may award little � if any � monetary recovery.

If you or a loved one was involved in a motorcycle accident and sustained fractures, broken bones, or traumatic head injuries, you may be able to make a personal injury claim for damages. pages.title: Nursing Home Fall Injuries in Anniston | Negligent Care

pages.h1: Nursing Home Fall Injuries in Anniston
pages.content_md:
The elderly are at a higher risk for falls and the injuries associated with them than any other age group. While falls can happen anywhere and at any time, they are more likely to happen in nursing homes. The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services estimates that 50 percent of all nursing home residents fall every year. Also, approximately 10 percent of those falls result in serious injury.

When an elderly person experiences nursing home fall injuries in Anniston, it may be important that they or their family speaks to a nursing home abuse lawyer in Anniston who could help them with their case.

There are many causes of falls among the elderly, but there are certain causes that are most common in nursing homes. These include:

- Confusion: elders are more likely to fall if they are confused because it can cause them to miss dangers in their path
- Certain medications: when patients take the wrong medication, or staff does not monitor them shortly after taking new medication, they can become sleepy and dizzy
- Unsafe areas: when there is a poorly lit walkway, a slippery floor, a bed height that is too high, or clutter creating obstacles in a nursing home
- Ignoring calls for help: elders often need a lot of help in daily tasks. When these calls go unanswered, an elder may try to do it on their own
- Broken equipment: many nursing homes lack proper funding, and this means that they may not have the ability to invest in certain equipment the way they should

While there are many causes of falls in nursing homes, these are the most common, and they are all preventable.

Residents may be embarrassed following a fall, particularly if it happened around other patients or staff members, but the resulting nursing home fall injuries in Anniston can be much more dangerous at that.

Many falls result in broken bones, especially broken hips that can be painful and leave someone permanently immobile. Even with proper care, broken bones put elders at risk for other injuries and infections. Falls also put elders at risk of head and brain injuries. These types of nursing home fall injuries in Anniston injuries can be fatal for anyone, but the elderly are particularly at risk.

If an elderly person breaks a rib or other bone that punctures an internal organ or tissue, they can be at risk for internal bleeding. Internal bleeding can cause other symptoms that are especially dangerous for elderly patients.

Since older individuals often have compromised immune systems that cannot help the body heal after a fall, they are especially at risk for infections. These infections may not heal and can prove fatal. Finally, a fall can leave an elderly person with lasting mental scars. A fall may cause someone to lose confidence in their abilities and can even lead to depression. If this depression is severe enough, a person may not want to recover, hindering their recovery.

Slip and falls can result in serious injury, but those injuries are often much more severe when it is an elder that falls. If you or a loved one suffered from nursing home fall injuries in Anniston, it may be important to get the help you need from an Anniston lawyer. An attorney could review your case and may be able to help you recover compensation for those injuries. Call today for a free consultation.

pages.title: Types of Abuse in Anniston Nursing Homes | Negligent Elderly Care
pages.description: If you or a loved one has experienced nursing home abuse in Anniston, you should learn more about the different types of abuse in Anniston nursing home in order to build a strong civil case.
pages.h1: Types of Abuse in Anniston Nursing Homes
pages.content_md:
Elder abuse is a growing problem in today�s world. Knowing the different types of abuse in Anniston nursing homes could help loved ones recognize them as they occur. And this could help them act before they suffer any permanent damage.

If you believe a loved one is suffering from abuse in an Anniston nursing home, it may be important you speak with a passionate attorney who could help you with your case. Contact an Anniston nursing home abuse lawyer to learn more.

According to the National Center on Elder Abuse, there are seven main types of abuse in Anniston nursing homes that could potentially occur:

- Physical abuse
- sexual abuse
- Financial abuse

Physical abuse occurs when a staff member, or members, of the nursing home use force to cause harm, pain, or injury to a resident. While using the hands or an object to strike a resident are often the most common types of physical abuse, it can also include shoving, burning, biting, or kicking them. When staff members force-feed or give elders medication inappropriately, it can also be physical abuse.

Sexual abuse is when a staff member forces themselves onto an elder in a sexual manner. This can include intercourse, non-consensual nudity, unwanted touching, or taking sexual photos of an elder, such as when they are getting dressed.

Psychological abuse, or emotional abuse, occurs when a staff member causes an elder to feel mental distress or pain either verbally or non-verbally. Psychological abuse often includes humiliating, insulting, threatening, or intimidating the elder. It can also include restricting the person from normal activities such as visiting with family because they did not comply. When the nursing home staff isolates an elder in their own room for long periods of time or gives them the silent treatment, this could also be a type of psychological abuse.

There are also other types of abuse in Anniston nursing homes which involves neglect:

- Neglect
- Self-Neglect
- Abandonment

Neglect involves failing to provide a resident with proper care. This can include not helping them groom themselves properly, refusing them basic needs such as food, shelter, or clothing, and not taking proper care to ensure the elder is safe.

Neglect does not always occur when a staff member of a nursing home does not properly care for an elder person. In some cases, the person could neglect to properly care for themselves such as refusing to use hearing aids or failing to properly clean up after themselves. Nursing home staff should always ensure they take care of the elder, even when the elder will not take care of themselves. Because of this, self-neglect is also a type of abuse that is too common in nursing homes.

While neglect is more likely to occur in nursing homes than abandonment, that does not mean that this type of abuse never occurs. Abandonment occurs when a nursing home staff leaves an elder on their own with no care at all. This could occur in a nursing home if a staff member took an elder for a walk and left them outside with no care at all.

There are other types of abuse in Anniston nursing homes which involve monetary value:

This type of abuse can be very hard to detect, even for the victim. Financial abuse occurs when a nursing home staff member uses an elder�s finances or property in an inappropriate way. This can include taking an elder�s bank card and stealing valuable jewelry or other valuables out of their room.

Family members should always be on the lookout for different types of abuse in order to stop it from happening as soon as possible. No one wants to think their loved one suffered abuse, but it is important to consider to keep elders as safe as possible.

When elders suffer abuse in a nursing home, there is help. An attorney could help families take the necessary action to not only stop the abuse, but also get the elder any compensation they may deserve. Abuse can not only cause pain and suffering for the elder, but could also result in high medical bills to treat injuries and other expenses.

If you suspect a loved one suffered one or more�types of abuse in Anniston nursing homes, contact an Anniston nursing home abuse lawyer who could help.

pages.title: Warning Signs of Nursing Home Neglect in Anniston
pages.description: If you believe that you or a loved is experience nursing home negligence, speak with a knowledgeable attorney to learn about the warning signs of nursing home neglect in Anniston.
pages.h1: Warning Signs of Nursing Home Neglect in Anniston
pages.content_md:
While neglect in a nursing home is a type of abuse, it differs slightly from what the law considers to be actual abuse. Nursing home abuse involves an intent to hurt or injure the elder while nursing home neglect is a breach, or failure, to care for the elder.

When referring to neglect, that failure to properly care for the elder could result in harm or injury to them. It is very important that family and loved ones watch for signs of nursing home abuse, as the elder may not be able to voice concern for the lack of care, or may even feel ashamed and embarrassed and choose not to tell anyone.

If you or someone you love suffered nursing home neglect, it is important that you speak to an Anniston nursing home abuse lawyer who could help your loved one claim compensation they may be entitled to. A knowledgeable attorney may be able to provide more insight about the warning signs of nursing home neglect in Anniston.

For loved ones to recognize the warning signs of nursing home neglect in Anniston, they must first understand the different types of neglect that can occur. In nursing homes, there are typically four different kinds of neglect.

- The first is emotional or social neglect: This type of neglect involves staff members continuously ignoring an elder, leaving them by themselves, or yelling at them.
- The second form of neglect is neglect of personal hygiene: Elders often need help with their laundry, bathing, brushing their teeth, and keeping their rooms clean and orderly. When they do not receive this care, it can be nursing home neglect.
- The third is neglect of basic needs: Nursing homes must provide for residents in a variety of ways. At the base of this care is ensuring they have food, water, and a safe environment. When they do not, this can also be nursing home neglect.

Finally, there is medical neglect. Elders often need help getting the right medication and if they suffer from cuts, diseases, or mobility issues, the nursing home staff should ensure they provide help. When they do not, the elder may have been subject to nursing home neglect.

In some cases of nursing home neglect, there are no warning signs, which can make it even more difficult for loved ones to identify it when the neglect is happening. Some of the most common warning signs of nursing home neglect in Anniston are:

- Significant weight loss that happens somewhat suddenly
- Visible bedsores
- Possible injuries from falls
- Chapped lips or dry skin
- Sunken cheeks and eyes combined with weakness
- Other behavior changes
- Not interacting with the nursing home staff or other residents
- Unsuitable living conditions in the nursing home

It is important for family members to realize that some of these signs can be difficult to detect, particularly behavioral changes. This is especially true when family members live far away and do not have a chance to visit their loved one in the nursing home often.

If any signs of nursing home neglect are evident at any time, it is important that family members try to visit often, and document any signs of neglect they may observe.

If you think your loved one is suffering from neglect at a nursing home, it is important that they get the help they need. A lawyer in Anniston may be able to help you and your family to remove the elder from the home faster and get the elder any compensation they may deserve to cover future medical bills, as well as compensation for pain and suffering. Contact an experienced attorney learn more about the warning signs of nursing home neglect in Anniston.

pages.content_md:
Premises liability law is a broad and intricate practice area. Generally, it involves the liability a property owner faces with people on their property. The duties of the property owner vary depending on the status of the visitor and the nature of the property. These two factors can be crucial in determining a potential legal outcome.

This complex area of law could be better understood with the help of an Anniston premises liability lawyer. As such, if you were injured because of someone else�s negligence and are considering filing a premises liability claim, you may want to retain an experienced personal injury attorney before doing so. With a qualified personal accident lawyer�s help, you could more effectively pursue the financial compensation to which you may be entitled.

Premises liability is a broad practice area that affects a large range of property types, including:

- Sporting events
- Stores
- Churches
- Hotels
- Restaurants

An injury suffered in one of these locations or a related location due to some existing and foreseeable hazard that the property�s owner should have remedied may be grounds for a premises liability claim. An Anniston premises liability attorney could assess a situation and determine its possible value in civil court.

The level of care, or amount of precaution, required by the property owner towards guests varies depending on whether the individual on the property has the status of an invitee or a trespasser. In Anniston, an invitee is defined as a visitor who enters someone�s property at the express or implied invitation of the owner for the owner�s benefit. Common examples of this include customers, contractors, friends and family, and employees.

In cases where a visitor is an invitee, a landowner has a duty to maintain their premises in a reasonably safe condition to ensure that individual�s safety. Alternatively, if the premises are unsafe, they have a duty to warn the invitee of any potential dangers. Under Alabama law, a property owner generally can be found liable through premises liability law if they failed to warn the invitee of a danger they knew about or should have known about.

In contrast to an invitee, courts in Anniston define a trespasser as someone who enters property without consent or who stays on that property after valid consent has expired. In Alabama, property owners owe less care to trespassers and therefore do not need to keep the premises safe for them nor warn them of unsafe conditions.

However, property owners may still be found liable for a trespasser�s injuries if they wantonly or intentionally injure them. This standard of care is substantially lower than the one for invitees. A Anniston premises liability lawyer could help differentiate between these two classifications and determine which one a potential client may fall under in the context of their case.

To understand the exact amount of care a property owner owed you prior to your injury on their property, you may want to employ the services of an Anniston premises liability lawyer. The required level of care owed to you varies depending on the circumstances, so it is important to ensure you understand what your role was in your situation. If you believe you or a loved one suffered injury due to a negligent party�s carelessness, you may be eligible for compensation for your injuries. Take action by calling local legal counsel today.

pages.content_md:

A plaintiff does not typically have to prove the absence of actual or constructive notice when the property owner intentionally created the hazard that caused the slip and fall injury. ## What Is the Difference Between Assault and Battery?

Under Georgia law:

Assault happens when someone intentionally causes another person to fear immediate violent harm.

You do not have to physically touch someone to be charged with assault.

Battery occurs when a person intentionally makes harmful or offensive physical contact with another person. This can include hitting, pushing, grabbing, or any unwanted touching that causes pain or injury.

Many criminal cases involve both assault and battery charges, especially when a confrontation turns physical.

## Simple vs. Aggravated Assault & Battery

- Use of a weapon

Felony convictions can carry years in prison and long-term consequences.
