pages.title: Bremen Personal Injury Lawyer | Negligent Accident Attorney
pages.description: If you have suffered injuries because of the negligent actions of another, it is important for you to contact a Bremen personal injury lawyer for help.
pages.content_md:
Whether you have been injured due to someone�s negligence in an accident, or by their intentional act, you have the right to pursue compensation in a civil claim. Regardless of any criminal

prosecution that may be pursued by the District Attorney�s office, injured people must initiate civil claims without government assistance.

Bremen personal injury lawyers work with individuals to pursue these claims in order to recover the fair compensation they deserve for their injuries.

The injuries suffered in these incidents can carry heavy medical bills as well as long-lasting pain and suffering, but insurance companies have a tendency to downplay the injuries, or even to blame the plaintiffs for the accident. Take a positive step towards protecting your rights and contact a dedicated injury attorney today.

Most claims for personal injury in Bremen arise out of accidents. Because of this, these cases are pursued under the theory of negligence. Negligence allows people injured in accidents to sue the responsible party for any damage that they cause.

State courts have identified five parts, or elements, that all plaintiffs alleging negligence must demonstrate. These are:

- Duty � In some situations, the law places a responsibility on a person to protect others. This is known as the duty of care. A person will never automatically have this duty, but may take it on by acting in certain ways. Examples of actions that give a person a duty to protect others include driving a car, owning a business, or being a property owner
- Breach � A breach of the duty of care occurs when the person holding the responsibility either acts or fails to act in a way that harms others. Examples here can include speeding while driving, not cleaning up a spill, or not repairing a hazardous structural condition
- Cause � The plaintiff must show that the defendant�s breach of the duty of care was the proximate cause of their injuries
- Scope � The injuries suffered must have been foreseeable from the facts of the case
- Damages � The plaintiff must have actual physical damages. Mental anguish, while certainly significant, cannot maintain a case on its own

Also, individuals must keep in mind that there is a time limit that a plaintiff must meet. This is known as the statute of limitations. Under state code, a plaintiff alleging personal injury has only two years from the date of the injury to initiate a court case.

While this may seem like a long time, the recovery process, as well as settlement negotiations, can take months. Time is of the essence and personal injury lawyers in Bremen should be contacted early on.

If you have been injured due to the acts of another, it can be difficult to know where to turn. Between medical bills, lost time at work, and stresses at home, these injuries can seriously disrupt a person�s life.

Unfortunately, the insurance companies do not make things easier by pressuring people to sign statements, or even by attempting to convince injured people that the accident was their fault. Let Bremen personal injury attorneys handle the insurance companies.

pages.title: Bremen Bicycle Accident Lawyer | Bike Wreck | Injured Cyclist Claims
pages.description: If you were struck by a car while riding your bike, you may be eligible for compensation. Call a Bremen bicycle accident lawyer for help filing your claim.
pages.content_md:
While biking is a great form of transportation and exercise, one collision with a careless or reckless driver can result in severe bodily trauma. A Bremen bicycle wreck lawyer could assist you in taking legal action if you suffer injuries in a bike wreck.

A bicyclist who is struck by a negligent driver may be eligible for significant financial compensation. An experienced personal injury attorney could help you pursue a fair compensatory award to covers all of your losses.

Motor vehicles are required to exercise reasonable care while driving in the vicinity of bikers. For example, per O.C.G.A. � 40-6-56, if a motorist does not maintain a distance of at least three feet while passing a bicyclist, the driver can be held liable in the event of a collision.

A Bremen bicycle accident lawyer could investigate the possible causes of a wreck if an injured cyclist wants to take legal action against the negligent party. Some bike wrecks commonly occur due to:

- Drivers illegally driving in designated bicycle lanes
- Cars failing to yield to cyclists
- Drivers opening their car doors while bicycle riders are passing by
- Speeding or reckless driving
- Failing to come to a complete stop at a sign or traffic light
- Driving while under the influence of alcohol or drugs
- Defective bike parts
- Poor road maintenance

An injured biker may need a Bremen bike accident attorney to help them evaluate their case so they can pursue compensation that allows them to recover for all of their losses. A plaintiff may seek recovery for both economic and emotional damages. The following are some examples of damages that an injured cyclist may be able to recover.

Money compensation may cover costs related to ambulance transportation, surgery, prescription medication, and rehabilitative services. Additionally, if their injuries result in permanent conditions, they may pursue payment for future medical bills.

An attorney could help an injured claimant obtain compensation for lost wages in the event they have to take an extended leave of absence from work.

State law permits plaintiffs to seek damages for emotional trauma such as pain and suffering. The term �pain and suffering� refers to the long-term physical discomfort and mental anguish that someone suffers as a result of an incident.

A bicyclist may seek punitive damages pursuant to O.C.G.A. �51-12-5.1 only if the accident involved one or more �aggravating circumstances� such as willful misconduct or malice on the part of the driver who hit them.

Getting hurt in a biking accident can result in devastating injuries that make it difficult to move around, earn a living, and enjoy life in a way you once did. Fortunately, by contacting a Bremen bicycle accident lawyer you could seek compensation from the party responsible and hold them accountable for their reckless actions. To learn more, schedule an initial case consultation with one of our caring and compassionate attorneys.

pages.title: Bremen Boat Accident Lawyer | Boating Collision Claims
pages.description: If you were injured in a boating wreck, a Bremen boat accident lawyer could explain your legal options and help you file a claim for damages.
pages.content_md:
Boat operators have a duty of care to drive their vessel responsibly in order to avoid injury to anyone on the water. Boaters who fail to meet this legal obligation can put themselves or someone they love in harm’s way. Additionally, in severe situations, these accidents can become fatal.

If a recreational boat accident harmed you or a loved one, you may be eligible to pursue a claim for compensation against those responsible. A Bremen boat accident lawyer could help you assert your rights in court and pursue fair compensation. A knowledgeable personal injury attorney could guide you through the legal nuances associated with boat wreck claims.

Similarly to other injury claims, boating accident claims tend to be based on the negligent actions of others. Therefore, when a boat owner or operator behaves recklessly, they could be liable for any damages that result. Some negligent behaviors from a boat driver that may give rise to a viable claim include:

- Inexperienced operation
- Speeding
- Boating while intoxicated
- Violating navigation rules

A claimant also may be able to hold a boat manufacturer responsible if the cause of a wreck was the vessel’s defective machinery. It is important to note that a claimant may still be able to recover compensation if they are partially to blame for their accident.

Under Official Georgia Code Annotated �51-11-7, if a court determines that a claimant is 49 percent or less to blame for an accident, they can recover damages minus their percentage of fault. If an individual exceeds this threshold the court may bar them from recovering completely. A Bremen attorney could determine who may be the negligent parties in a boating accident claim.

State law sets a two-year deadline for personal injury claims under O.C.G.A �9-3-33. While there may be some exceptions to this legal deadline, it is crucial for claimants following a boat wreck to meet the statute of limitations. A court may dismiss a lawsuit if an injured party submits their claim after the statute of limitations expires. A Bremen boat accident attorney could help an injured person meet all legal deadlines.

For a claim to be successful, lawyer may need to collect a variety of evidence. A claimant may need witnesses who can testify as to what happened in the boating wreck to establish the fault of the owner or driver. Additionally, an injured party may need medical evidence to demonstrate that the boating accident caused them to sustain injuries. A legal representative could gather evidence and strategize how to use it in a way that may benefit a plaintiff.

A Bremen boat accident lawyer could become your legal advocate throughout the claims process if a negligent individual caused you to suffer injuries. Not only could a legal professional identify who may be held accountable, an attorney could also help you build your case and file it in a timely manner. To learn how an attorney could help you, schedule a consultation today.

pages.title: Bremen Bus Accident Lawyer | Collision Involving Public Transit
pages.description: Contact a Bremen bus accident lawyer if you need help filing a claim for damages after a collision involving public transit.
pages.content_md:
Buses are a popular and important form of public transportation. Unfortunately, these modes of transportation can become involved in serious collisions. Bus accidents � though rare � often result in not just many serious bodily injuries but also fatalities. If a bus company does not exercise a standard level of care, anyone injured in an accident relating to its negligent behavior may have a valid claim for damages.

Following a wreck involving public transit, you should be able to find out whether you qualify for compensation by working with a Bremen bus accident lawyer. A personal injury attorney has the training necessary to investigate the cause of the accident and to build a claim on your behalf that credibly shows your entitlement to damages.

Common carriers can be any person or business that transports people or goods for a fee. Both federal and state regulations impose additional responsibilities on bus companies and other common carriers. For example, bus drivers are subject to strict hours of service (HOS) limitations while their employers have specific obligations when it comes to hiring employees and monitoring their performance.

It can be a challenge to identify who is responsible for causing a bus wreck, especially since more than one party is potentially at fault. A seasoned Bremen bus accident attorney could assess the situation surrounding a case and determine who may be at fault.

A bus company may be held liable in the event that an accident occurs under respondeat superior, which means that an employer must take responsibility for its employee�s actions. A lawyer could investigate whether this legal responsibility applies to a potential defendant.

A bus driver can be liable for damages if an accident occurs due to their negligent behavior. Reckless misconduct that constitutes negligence may include speeding, texting while driving, or drinking on the job.

A mechanical defect � such as defective brakes or tires � that causes a bus crash may lead to a manufacturer being at fault. These companies have a legal obligation to ensure that the parts they produce do not have any dangerous defects. If a bus part company did not take reasonable steps to ensure this, they could be held accountable for any damages that result.

Often due to a combination of a lack of seatbelts and the sheer weight of the vehicle, a bus accident can result in any number of serious injuries. A bus that is involved in a high-speed collision also runs a high risk of rolling over, which can lead to bodily harm such as:

- Broken bones
- Whiplash
- Burns
- Traumatic brain injury (TBI)
- Spine trauma

Someone who sustains one or more injuries of this nature may be eligible for significant financial compensation. State law allows injured parties to recover damages for past and future medical expenses, lost wages, pain and suffering, and other losses. A Bremen lawyer who is familiar with bus accident cases could asses a claimant�s injuries and identify the damages to which they are entitled.

The laws governing lawsuits involving public transit or commercial passenger vehicles can be complicated. As a result, it is strongly advised to consult a Bremen bus accident lawyer if you have suffered injuries in a wreck. Contact an attorney today for help on your case.

pages.title: Bremen Car Accident Lawyer | Automobile Injuries
pages.description: If you or a loved one has been injured in a Bremen car accident, speak with a Bremen car accident lawyer to learn more about seeking compensation.
pages.content_md:
In 2015, there were thousands of serious injuries in the state due to car accidents, according to the Georgia Governor�s Office of Highway Safety. When the cost of hospital bills and missed work begins to add up, many car accident victims rightfully wonder who is liable for their damages.

In general, the answer is the driver whose careless behavior caused the accident. However, seeking redress for your damages is not always as simple as pointing to the driver who harmed you. You may need a passionate attorney who can fight for you. Contact a�Bremen car accident lawyer today.

In Bremen, the responsibility for a car accident will be on the driver who behaved negligently in the circumstances. Negligence is a legal term that describes when a certain behavior falls below how society would expect a reasonable person to behave in the same circumstances.

When this unreasonable behavior causes a car accident, the driver will be legally liable. Of course, it is not as simple as that and the law becomes more complicated when multiple drivers are behaving unreasonably or when the victim is partial to blame. Speak with a�Bremen car accident lawyer to learn more about liability in Bremen car accidents.

Although there are various ways a driver can breach their duty to others on the road, there are some more common scenarios where a driver might be liable for an accident. For instance, violating the traffic code is one of the most common causes of serious wrecks.

Driving higher than the posted speed limit is one of the leading causes of accidents. According to the Georgia Governor�s Office of Highway Safety, speeding accounted for 19 percent of the state�s traffic fatalities in 2015. Like speeding, a driver who ignores traffic signs or lights may cause an accident and could cause damage to the other drivers or pedestrians in the intersection.

Additionally, it is illegal to drive while impaired in Bremen. According to Section 40-6-391 of the Georgia Code, a driver is legally impaired by alcohol if their Blood Alcohol Content (BAC) is above 0.08 percent. Under Section 40-6-391(a)(2), a driver is impaired by drugs if they are under the influence of a drug that makes them any less safe to drive. Besides drugs and alcohol, drivers can be impaired in other ways, too. For example, a driver may be impaired because of sleep deprivation, old age, or inexperience. A Bremen car accident lawyer could potentially reference these common situations when building a strong civil case.

The definition of distracted driving is relatively more imprecise. It generally covers any activity that takes the driver�s attention or focus off the road. While this obviously includes texting while driving, it can also include talking on the phone while driving in certain situations.

For example, a driver may be distracted if they were not using a hands-free device. Other common examples of distracted driving include eating or drinking while driving, adjusting the navigation or temperature settings, or even having a conversation with a passenger in the backseat � which often leads the driver to glance behind them and not look at the road.

If you suffered injuries in a car accident, you may be wondering who is liable for your damages. If your accident was the result of another driver�s negligence or recklessness, they may have to compensate you. However, this can be a complicated process.

To learn more about your legal options, you should contact a Bremen car accident lawyer with experience in litigating car accident suits. An attorney may have the knowledge of Bremen laws and experience in litigating these types of cases.

pages.title: Bremen Front-End Car Accident Lawyer | Head-On Collision
pages.description: A Bremen front-end car accident lawyer could help you take legal action against the reckless motorist who caused your head-on collision.
pages.content_md:
Head-on collisions can be devastating for any occupants in either vehicle involved. Most front-end car accidents take place on two-way roads lacking a center divider, with speeding and alcohol use being the most significant contributing factors.

Consider contacting a Bremen front-end car accident lawyer if either you or someone you love suffered injuries in a wreck. A car wreck attorney could hold the at-fault driver liable, in which case you may be able to obtain significant money damages.

Most front-end car wrecks occur when one reckless driver crosses over the middle lane into oncoming traffic. For instance, if a motorist becomes distracted by another passenger or their cellphone, they could cross over the middle lane without realizing it.

Another common cause of these collisions is when a driver chooses to get behind the wheel while intoxicated or impaired by drugs. An inebriated motorist could unknowingly drive the wrong way on a one-way street and crash head-on into another vehicle. Depending on the cause of someone�s front-end car accident, a Bremen lawyer could build a case and work to get an injured claimant the compensation they need.

One of the most important roles that an attorney plays in a Bremen head-on collision case is evaluating a claimant�s losses and determining the types of compensation they may be eligible to receive. As Georgia is an at-fault state, the motorist responsible for causing the wreck may have to pay various types of damages.

Serious injuries � such as those one could sustain in a head-on crash � may require years of treatment and recovery. Therefore, an injured party may be able to seek damages for past and future medical costs in their lawsuit.

Even a relatively low-speed front-end accident can result in thousands of dollars of repair costs. Sometimes, these costs may approximate or exceed the value of the damaged vehicle. In these situations, the court may require the negligent driver to pay for the repair or replacement costs.

Being involved in a serious car wreck can leave someone unable to return to work and earn a living, be it on a temporary or permanent basis. As a result, an individual could demand compensation for the valuable income they lost while recovering in addition to damages for their lost earning capacity.

Noneconomic damages compensate someone for how their injuries negatively affected their quality of life. Some examples include pain and suffering, disfigurement, and disability. These damages can be difficult to quantify; therefore, it is important to have an experienced attorney that could ensure that these losses are assessed appropriately.

A claimant may obtain punitive damages if the at-fault driver acted maliciously or egregiously given the set of circumstances. For example, a plaintiff may receive these damages if the defendant drove while impaired by drugs or alcohol. The court awards these damages to deter similar behavior in the future and to punish the defendant.

A front-end collision can total your vehicle and leave you with serious, life-threatening injuries. Depending on the circumstances, you could be eligible for various types of compensation. Contact a Bremen front-end car accident lawyer for information on your legal rights and options, as well as possible next steps moving forward.

pages.title: Bremen Parking Lot Accident Lawyer | Garage Collision Case
pages.description: If you were involved in a collision in a parking area or garage, you should speak with a Bremen parking lot accident lawyer to dicuss your legal options.
pages.content_md:
You may think that parking lot wrecks are relatively minor, given how they typically happen at low speeds. However, some of these collisions can result in serious bodily injuries � especially if the injured party is a pedestrian. Accidents that take place in parking lots and garages tend to have a connection to inattentive or aggressive driving, poor lighting conditions, blinds spots, congestion, and high foot traffic.

Consider contacting a Bremen parking lot accident lawyer if you have been injured either as a pedestrian or a motorist in such an incident. A car wreck attorney could conduct an in-depth investigation of how the wreck happened and begin working on a civil suit for damages. If someone acted negligently � be it a motorist in the parking lot or maybe even the garage�s owner � you may be eligible to obtain compensation for all your injuries and property damage.

Because many parties are interacting in parking spaces, there could be various individuals who are liable in the event of a crash. Depending on the circumstances, a parking garage accident attorney in Bremen could pursue compensation on an individual�s behalf from one or more potential defendants.

In Bremen, the plaintiff in a parking garage accident case may need to show that the negligent actions of a motorist caused their injuries. Holding a driver liable requires the claimant to establish several elements of negligence recognized under state law, those being duty, breach, causation, and damages.

A motorist may breach their duty of care by violating a traffic law, even when they are not traveling on the road. For instance, an attorney could hold a reckless driver accountable if they injured the plaintiff because they were distracted, driving while intoxicated, speeding, or ignoring traffic signs and signals.

Property owners� including those who own parking lots � have an ongoing legal obligation to make sure that their facilities are free of hazards and are generally safe for the public to use. If a parking garage owner fails to meet this obligation and injury results, they could potentially be responsible for paying the injured party damages. There are many examples of situations that could cause a parking lot owner to face legal consequences, such as not promptly fixing potholes, failing to adequately light the lot, or disregarding the accumulation of snow or ice.

In some cases, a plaintiff may be partially to blame for their losses. When this happens, a court may review a case and determine what percentage of fault the claimant played in contributing to their losses. If a claimant is 49 percent or less at fault, they may still recover damages. However, a court may reduce this person�s compensatory award by their percentage of fault.

For example, this scenario may come into play if the plaintiff was highly intoxicated and walking erratically through the lot at the time a distracted motorist struck them. An experienced attorney in Bremen could assess a parking lot accident case and identify whether a claimant may be partially at fault.

You may be driving or walking through a parking lot when out of nowhere, you are struck by a vehicle and become badly injured. If this has recently happened to you, be sure to contact a Bremen parking lot accident lawyer to explore the possibility of taking legal action. To get started on your case, schedule a consultation with one of our dedicated attorneys.

pages.title: Bremen Rear-End Car Accident Lawyer | Tailgating Collision
pages.description: If a negligent driver was driving too closely behind you and collided into your vehicle, contact a Bremen rear-end car accident lawyer.
pages.content_md:
A serious car wreck can occur in any number of different ways � from a relatively minor fender-bender to a high-speed collision resulting in extensive property damage and serious bodily harm. One of the most common types of auto collisions are rear-end car accidents. These have a wide array of causes, such as tailgating, driving while distracted, and reduced road traction due to rainy weather.

If you recently have sustained an injury in a car crash and would like to know what your legal options are, contact a car wreck attorney for guidance. A Bremen rear-end car accident lawyer could build a claim for damages and help establish defendant negligence.

Depending on the circumstances of a tailgating crash, an individual may suffer one or more serious injuries. An experienced Bremen lawyer could prepare a rear-end car accident case and pursue compensation on behalf of a claimant based on the severity of their injuries.

Whiplash is caused by a rapid, back-and-forth movement of the neck. This injury is the most commonly found in rear-end accidents. Symptoms of whiplash can vary considerably and may include neck pain, loss of range of motion, headaches, dizziness, and difficulty sleeping.

The force of impact during a rear-end collision can exert tremendous pressure on the spine. Specifically, it can cause a motorist to suffer a compressed or herniated disc, which can be costly to treat and rehab.

Although proven to save lives, airbags also may cause certain injuries. The force of a deploying airbag may result in broken bones, contusions, and abrasions on the face and torso.

One of the worst conditions that someone in a tailgating accident may sustain is a traumatic brain injury (TBI). Like whiplash, symptoms of a TBI can be slow to develop. They may include dizziness, fatigue, impaired decision-making abilities, and abnormal behavioral changes. TBIs can have long-term effects and therefore may require extensive medical care.

A widespread misconception when it comes to rear-end car accidents is that the following driver is always completely at fault. While this may be true in many cases, other parties can be liable in some situations. For instance, the leading motorist could be partially at fault if they suddenly changed lanes without signaling or slammed on the brakes. Additionally, if the leading car had a broken taillight, this may result in an accident because the following driver was not able to tell that the person in front of them was slowing down.

In situations such as these, both the plaintiff and the defendant may be legally to blame. According to state law, plaintiffs can be awarded damages but only if they are 49 percent or less to blame for their losses. Then, a court may reduce a claimant�s compensation by their percentage of fault. A Bremen lawyer could assess the cause of a rear-end car wreck case and determine how to build a claim based on these facts.

Being rear-ended on the road can amount to more than just a major annoyance. Even if it was a low-speed collision, you may have sustained a serious injury. Contact a Bremen rear-end car accident lawyer today for information on whether you may be able to obtain compensation from the at-fault party. Call today.

pages.title: Bremen Side-Impact Car Accident Lawyer | T-Bone Collision
pages.description: If you were involved in a T-bone collision, you should speak with a Bremen side-impact car accident lawyer to discuss your legal options.
pages.content_md:
Side-impact car accidents can be some of the most devastating motor vehicle collisions. They typically occur when the front of one vehicle violently crashes into the side of another, injuring or potentially killing one or more passengers. Despite the use of modern safety technologies, these wrecks account for roughly one-quarter of all passenger vehicle fatalities in the United States each year.

Contact a Bremen side-impact car accident lawyer if either you or a loved one has suffered injuries in a T-bone collision. A seasoned car wreck attorney could maximize your chances of being awarded compensation and holding the at-fault driver legally accountable.

Most T-bone collisions occur because one or more motorist violates a traffic law or recklessly operates their vehicle. For instance, barreling through a red light or past a stop sign is incredibly dangerous driving behavior and one of the leading causes of side-impact car wrecks.

A side-impact accident may take place when a driver attempts to make a left-hand turn without properly yielding to oncoming traffic. According to traffic laws, drivers turning left must yield to traffic traveling in the opposite direction until it is safe to proceed.

However, not every T-bone accident happens at an intersection. Speeding, drunk driving, distracted operation of a motor vehicle, and driving too fast in poor weather conditions are additional ways that these wrecks may potentially occur. A skilled attorney in Bremen could determine the cause of a side-impact crash and decide how to pursue a claim based on this information.

In Bremen, being involved in even a relatively minor side-impact auto wreck can leave someone seriously injured and badly in need of help from an attorney. Those hurt in these accidents may suffer the following types of injuries:

Any blunt force delivered to the head can cause traumatic brain injury (TBI). Head trauma can have anywhere from mild, temporary symptoms to severe effects that cause debilitating cognitive problems.

Whiplash is a type of injury frequently that is caused by an abrupt forward and/or backward jerking motion of the neck. Whiplash can have significant side-effects that result in costly medical treatment.

An injured driver may pursue compensation for broken bones, as it is common in this type of accident for limbs to be slammed into the door, dashboard, or other parts of the car.

Blunt force trauma can cause internal bleeding. Symptoms of internal bleeding vary widely depending on the location and severity of the hemorrhage. It can lead to hemorrhagic shock or death if not promptly treated.

Being injured in a T-bone auto wreck can be a terrifying experience with lifelong consequences. Still, state law provides a means by which you can obtain compensation for all your expenses and losses. Contact a knowledgeable and dedicated Bremen side-impact car accident lawyer today to begin exploring your available legal options.

pages.title: Bremen Car Wreck Cases Involving Texting While Driving
pages.description: A lawyer could help you pursue a car wreck case in Bremen if it involved a party who was texting while driving. For more information, call today.
pages.h1: Bremen Car Wreck Cases Involving Texting While Driving
pages.content_md:
State law prohibits motorists from using their phones while operating their motor vehicles. Unfortunately, many drivers violate this law and cause accidents due to their distraction.

If you have been injured in a motor vehicle accident and suspect the at-fault driver was texting, then you may have a viable claim for damages. However, Bremen car wreck cases involving texting while driving can be complex to pursue without help from an attorney. Therefore, you should speak with a lawyer before taking legal action.

In Bremen, one of the most crucial steps a lawyer should take in these distracted driving cases is to obtaining evidence that shows that the defendant was texting while behind the wheel and that these reckless actions caused the accident. While sometimes difficult to accomplish, various forms of evidence can help prove driver negligence.

One of the primary sources of evidence in these cases are the defendant�s cell phone records. These may show the time and date that the at-fault driver was using their phone, and therefore if they were distracted by their electronic device before the wreck.

Although witness testimony is not always reliable, it can be strong evidence if two or more witnesses can provide corroborating information regarding whether a driver was texting immediately prior to an accident.

Police and other first responders may have been at the scene of the accident and inquired about cell phone use to determine the cause of the car crash. Then, law enforcement may add this information to the accident report. This is potentially strong evidence that a lawyer in Bremen could use to build a case.

In Bremen, the law prohibits all motorists from holding or using a cell phone while driving. Therefore, it is illegal to write, send, or read any text-based communications while operating a motor. The statewide ban on texting while driving applies to cellphones, tablets, laptops, and all other similar electronic devices.

There are, however, a few exceptions to the general prohibition against texting while driving. One may do so as a means of reporting a motor vehicle accident, medical emergency, fire, or road hazard. Additionally, first responders may use electronic devices to perform work duties as well as public utility employees and contractors when responding to an emergency. A lawyer in Bremen could review a car wreck case involving cell phone usage to determine whether a defendant violated the law.

Texting while driving can put everyone on the road at risk for injury. Therefore, if you have a Bremen car wreck case involving texting while driving, you should take legal action to hold the reckless driver accountable for their actions. A seasoned attorney could help you collect evidence demonstrating the defendant was using their phone at the time of the accident in addition to advocating for your claim. To get started on your case, call today.

pages.title: Bremen Catastrophic Injury Lawyer | Life-Changing Accidents
pages.description: If you suffered severe injuries in an accident, a Bremen catastrophic injury lawyer may be able to pursue compensation on your behalf. Call today.
pages.content_md:
In general, the courts define catastrophic injuries as those that result in long-term, if not permanent, damage. If you sustained these types of injuries in a severe accident, you may be entitled to take legal action. A seasoned personal injury attorney could help you pursue a civil lawsuit if someone’s actions caused your catastrophic injuries.

Because these injuries often result in a temporary or permanent disability, you may not be able to work anymore, and your medical bills could be significant. Fortunately, a dedicated Bremen catastrophic injury lawyer could explain your rights and how you may be able to recover from the at-fault party.

Accidents that result in severe bodily harm could lead to permanent life-changing damage. As a result, these individuals may find that their body or mind does not function the way it used to.

These types of injuries may occur in any type of incident. However, some common causes of serious bodily harm may include accidents at work, car crashes, medical malpractice, and the use of dangerous and defective products. A Bremen lawyer could assess the cause of a catastrophic injury and determine how a claimant�s specific bodily harm may impact their case. Some examples of massive harm a person may experience include:

- Third-degree burns
- Paralysis
- Spinal cord damage
- Amputation
- Deafness or blindness
- Nerve injury
- Organ damage or failure
- Brain trauma
- Shattered bones

When a person acts carelessly or recklessly in a certain situation, the court may describe their behavior as negligent. Depending on the situation, a defendant may owe the plaintiff a duty of care to act a certain way when engaging with this person. According to Official Code of Georgia Annotated �51-1-1, a wrongful act occurs when someone violates their duty of care to another person. To recover compensation for a claimant in a catastrophic injury case, a Bremen lawyer must prove that the defendant owed the plaintiff a duty of care, and then breached this legal obligation.

An attorney also must demonstrate a connection between the defendant�s actions and the claimant�s losses. Meaning, that an individual may not be held accountable for any damages they did not cause. Once this is established, the plaintiff must show the full extent of their harm.

Typically, a person can claim for lost wages, current and future medical bills, the physical and emotional harm related to living with the injury, and other related costs. Depending on the situation, an injured party may be able to claim punitive damages if the defendant acted with gross negligence, recklessness, or intentionally.

Catastrophic injury cases can be incredibly complicated, and therefore, require competent legal counsel to litigate successfully. A Bremen catastrophic injury lawyer could become your legal advocate throughout this process and work to hold the negligent party accountable for their reckless actions. If you sustained significant or permanent bodily harm in an accident, contact our office for help filing a claim for damages.

pages.title: Bremen Burn Injury Lawyer | Electrical | Chemical | Thermal
pages.description: A Bremen burn injury lawyer has the knowledge and experience needed to advocate on behalf of burn victims. Call today to discuss your case.
pages.content_md:
Severe burns can cause permanent disfigurement or disability, and individuals who suffer these injuries may have difficulty returning to their everyday routine. Therefore, if another person’s action caused you to sustain severe burns, you may have a viable claim for damages.

A Bremen burn injury lawyer could help you understand your rights and what to expect during the legal process. Additionally, a well-practiced attorney could help you pursue compensation for your medical bills, physical and emotional pain, lost wages, and other losses.

Severe heat-related injuries typically occur when something catches on fire or explodes. For instance, in serious car wrecks, an engine may explode or spark a flame, injuring the occupants inside.

Accidental exposure to harmful substances also may result in a severe chemical burn. Additionally, individuals may sustain electrical burns in situations where a negligent electrician fails to conduct their service carefully and responsibly.

In other situations, a defendant may have started a fire intentionally. In these cases, an injured claimant could still pursue a civil lawsuit while the state takes legal action against their criminal behavior. Regardless of the cause, a Bremen burn injury attorney could assist a claimant in filing a lawsuit against the at-fault party.

Burns can serious physical injuries, permanent disabilities, disfigurement, and in some cases, death. Medical professionals categorize burn injuries based on these effects as well as other factors. A lawyer in Bremen could determine the value of a claim based on the severity of a person�s burn injury.

First-degree burns at the least serious that may only require gels or cold water to treat. These injuries typically involve the top layer of skin sustaining damage, and there may be inflammation.

These injuries may affect the top few layers of skin and could result in blisters. The healing process for these heat-related injuries may take months.

In situations involving third-degree burns, all layers of the skin and some underlying tissue may be destroyed. These injuries may need immediate medical treatment and may result in permanent scarring.

These injuries are some of the most severe types of burns. Not only may an individual suffer skin damage, but the burn injury may reach an individual�s bones or organs as well. Additionally, a person’s nerves may be permanently damaged, and they may require skin grafts.

When an individual or a company is responsible for a burn injury, they may be liable for any damages that a person suffers. A Bremen lawyer could review the circumstances surrounding a burn injury case and identify what types of damages a� claimant may be able to pursue. A claimant may be able to recover compensation for:

- Medical bills
- Rehabilitation costs
- Pain and suffering

pages.content_md:
The courts in Bremen, Georgia take nursing home abuse very seriously. If you believe a loved one has suffered abuse or neglect at the hands of their caretakers in a nursing home facility, time is of the essence. An experienced Bremen nursing home abuse lawyer knows this well and subsequently may be able to help remedy your loved one�s substandard treatment. Nursing home abuse is more common than many people realize because it often goes underreported. In many cases, this is because seniors in nursing home facilities are hesitant to report abuse. They may fear retaliation if they are not believed, or they may feel guilty or ashamed that they do not have control over their situation.

Some nursing home patients may not want to inconvenience or upset their family members, especially in situations and areas where locating and deciding on an affordable nursing home facility is particularly challenging. Regardless of the circumstances, it is important for families with loved ones in assisted care facilities to be aware of the various signs and symptoms of nursing home abuse and neglect. Nursing home abuse and neglect can take many forms and is often easy to hide.� Physical abuse can leave marks and bruises, but these might be explained away by an elderly resident�s tendency to bruise more easily clumsiness, or blood clotting issues.

Sexual abuse is less common than physical abuse, but often the signs are not as apparent. Verbal and emotional abuses do not leave direct physical signs, but are no less damaging, potentially causing intense depression, anxiety, fear, shame, and guilt.

There are numerous signs of nursing home abuse and neglect, some more insidious than others. While some symptoms, like anxiety or depression, appear in nursing home residents who have not been abused, these symptoms may instead raise red flags about nursing home abuse, especially when they are coupled with other additional symptoms and signs that something is wrong.

Common physical signs of neglect in nursing homes include bruises, bumps, marks, contusions, bed sores and infections, sexually transmitted diseases, and self-injury. Soiled clothes and linens, unchanged adult diapers, and self-injury can also suggest abuse.

Family members may also have cause for concern if an elderly relative expresses new or intensifying anxiety, depression, anger, loss of appetite, or fear of a certain staff member.

Finally, certain actions committed by a nursing home staff member or administrator can qualify as abuse regardless of the end result. Unnecessary isolation or restraint, medication errors, withholding necessities such as food or medication, and lack of access to a doctor or therapist are all abuses that may incur liability in civil court. A�Bremen nursing home abuse lawyer can help individuals hold the at-fault party responsible.

Any type of nursing home abuse or neglect can affect the health and healing capacities of a nursing home resident, and in extreme cases may even lead to premature death. As soon as you learn about or even suspect nursing home abuse, it is important to work with a nursing home abuse attorney who can help you investigate the nursing home facility and make sure that your loved one is safe.

If nursing home abuse is established, you can pursue a personal injury claim to hold the nursing home facility and any staff members involved personally responsible. Contact an experienced Bremen nursing home abuse lawyer for help evaluating your case and potentially opening up a lawsuit.

pages.title: Types of Abuse in Bremen Nursing Homes | Abusive & Negligent Care
pages.description: If you or a loved one suffered nursing home abuse in Bremen and are planning to file a civil suit, it is important to learn more about the types of abuse in Bremen nursing homes.
pages.h1: Types of Abuse in Bremen Nursing Homes
pages.content_md:
It can be difficult for families to make the decision to place their loved one in a nursing home. However, nursing homes could potentially end up being the best option to ensure an elder receives the proper care and medical attention they need. Abuse in a nursing home is tragic, and can a family�s worst fear.

To add to this, abuse is not always physical. There are many�types of abuse in Bremen nursing homes families may not even be aware of. As unpleasant as it is to think of, it is important that family members can identify the different types of abuse so they could take the necessary steps should it ever occur.

If you suspect your loved one is suffering abuse in a nursing home, it is important to contact a Bremen nursing home abuse lawyer right away. An attorney could help you take the proper steps and stop the abuse from happening as soon as possible.

Unfortunately, there are many different types of abuse in Bremen nursing homes and they each come with their own warning signs.

- Physical Abuse
- Sexual Abuse
- Emotional and Psychological Abuse
- Neglect and Staff Abuse

Physical abuse has many forms. Hitting or otherwise causing physical injury, pain, or impairment are all forms of physical abuse. Restraining a resident in an improper or illegal way is also another form of physical abuse. Restraints can be physical, such as bed restraints, or chemical, such as medicating a resident with the intent to sedate them.

Sexual abuse is any sexual contact that someone does not want or invite. But in nursing homes that prohibit sexual contact between residents and staff members, even if the resident gives consent, there may also be a case of sexual abuse. This type of abuse can also occur if a staff member or other resident tries to have sexual contact with an elder who is not of sound mind and therefore unable to consent.

Like most types of abuse in Bremen nursing homes, emotional abuse can take many forms. Belittling, humiliating, insulting, or treating an elder like they are a child are all emotional abuse. If a staff member ignores a resident or otherwise inflicts pain or distress that is not physical, it could also be emotional abuse.

Just like anyone else, the elderly can sometimes become depressed or angry and this can cause them to stop caring for themselves. They may not bathe themselves or they may refuse to take their medication. It is up to the staff to make sure they care for residents, even when they do not want to care for themselves.

Elderly residents in a nursing home often rely on the staff to provide for their basic needs, as well as sometimes to provide companionship and friendship. When a staff member leaves a resident, whether physically in another location, or they suddenly end that companionship while still working in the home – it could be a form of abuse.

Whether a staff member forgets to provide a resident with basic care or willfully refuses to, neglect is a form of abuse. Nursing home staff must ensure they properly care for their residents at all times and when they are not, they could be guilty of neglect.

Nursing home staff often have access to a resident�s personal belongings including valuable jewelry, checks, and bank cards. When they exploit this and steal from an elder or convince them to give them money for the staff member�s own personal gain, this is financial abuse.

All types of abuse in Bremen nursing homes can be devastating for the elderly, as well as their family. Anytime someone suspects abuse, they should report it to local authorities, and they also should contact a Bremen nursing home abuse lawyer.

An attorney could help a nursing home resident claim compensation for expenses related to any suffered abuse, including the pain and suffering that may remain with them long after the abuse stops.

pages.title: Warning Signs of Nursing Home Neglect in Bremen

pages.h1: Warning Signs of Nursing Home Neglect in Bremen
pages.content_md:
Nursing home neglect is a tragic issue that takes place at many nursing homes across the country. Nursing homes are often understaffed leaving employees overworked, exhausted, and feeling unable to provide and care for their patients the way they should.

Still, the elderly are some of the nation�s most vulnerable citizens and staff members need to care for them properly. Unfortunately, they are not always able to ensure they receive that care.

Many elders do not report neglect because they do not realize it is happening, or they are simply too embarrassed to bring it to someone�s attention.

It is very important that their loved ones recognize the warning signs of nursing home neglect in Bremen so they can report it to the appropriate authorities. Loved ones could also speak to a nursing home abuse lawyer in Bremen if they suspect a case of neglect.

It can be difficult for family members to know what to look for when looking for warning signs of nursing home neglect in Bremen, but there are some common signs:

- Physical Symptoms
- Poor Conditions
- Malnutrition
- Lack of Activity
- Unexplained Injuries

The elderly often cannot care for themselves. For this reason, patients often need help getting themselves dressed, brushing their teeth, brushing their hair, clipping their nails, and bathing. Unfortunately, lack of proper dental care is also a major issue in nursing homes across the country. If a patient has problems eating, complains of tooth pain, or is otherwise appears dirty, it could be a sign they are suffering from nursing home neglect.

Nursing homes must keep a clean and safe place for their patients to live. This is important not only to provide them with a nice place to live, but also to protect their personal safety. When living spaces or common areas are cluttered, it could pose a risk of slip and falls. Also, when staff members do not change bed sheets or clean the bathrooms, it could pose a risk of infection or illness. Loved ones should always closely observe the conditions of the nursing home and if they are subpar, consider it one of the many warning signs of nursing home neglect in Bremen.

Many family members believe that if they are not visiting during mealtime, it can be difficult to detect signs of malnutrition. But there are physical signs they can watch for. Brittle hair, lack of appetite, trouble swallowing, dry skin, fatigue and exhaustion, and a distended abdomen are all signs that an elder may be malnourished.

Staying active is an important part of everyone�s health, but it is especially important for seniors who can suffer serious health conditions such as bedsores if left immobile for too long. If loved ones suspect an elder is not active enough, they should ask the facility if they have walking programs or exercise classes that can help residents stay active. Simply asking the elder what activity they last did, and when, can also indicate nursing home neglect.

Just like anyone else, the elderly can get hurt in several ways, and it does not always indicate neglect. But when there are inexplicable injuries, such as broken bones or bruises, it may be a sign of neglect. In some instances, even when injuries are explicable, it may indicate neglect. For instance, if an injury is the result of a fall, it could mean the staff left the patient to get out of bed alone – a case of neglect – and fell when doing so.

When someone sees the warning signs of nursing home neglect in Bremen, there are many things they can do to stop it or help their loved one move into another facility.

If you suspect your family member suffered neglect, contact an attorney right away. An attorney could help families file a personal injury claim that may help them receive compensation for any medical expenses associated with an injury, or for the pain and suffering the elder endured because of the neglect. A Bremen nursing home abuse lawyer could also explain to families what other steps are available. Call today for a free consultation.

pages.content_md:
According to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, 1,554 people died in traffic accidents in 2016. The NHTSA also reported that 232 pedestrian fatalities occurred in Georgia that same year.

No one wants to think about getting hit by a car as they enjoy their day. Unfortunately, pedestrian accidents happen daily, as experienced personal injury attorneys know all too well. If you are struck by a vehicle while walking, a Bremen pedestrian accident lawyer may be able to help you seek justice.

Pedestrian accidents happen for many reasons. Driver inattention is a common reason for car crashes, and in recent years has inspired the creation of laws banning drivers from using cellular phones while operating a vehicle. However, pedestrian accidents also may happen due to drivers not yielding at a crosswalk, turning a corner without looking, driving under the influence, or speeding.

A Bremen pedestrian accident attorney could help determine who was at fault in a particular accident by collecting evidence such as photographs and video of the accident site, police reports, and testimony from witnesses and accident reconstruction experts. Depending on the circumstances, various parties may bear some liability, including not just the driver involved but also other drivers in the area, employers of a negligent driver, municipal entities, and even the injured pedestrian themselves.

Although anyone can sustain injuries in a pedestrian accident, specific populations have higher risks of being struck. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) states seniors 65 and older represented 20 percent of pedestrian deaths.

Not all pedestrian involved in accidents die, but many suffer severe injuries. Some common injuries sustained by pedestrians struck by motor vehicles include:

- Brain Damage
- Severe bruises and lacerations
- Permanent scarring
- Fractured and broken bones
- Spinal cord trauma

Following a pedestrian accident, a consultation with legal counsel may be an important step towards recovery. A seasoned pedestrian accident lawyer in Bremen may be able to help a plaintiff recover damages for medical bills, as well as various other damages.

Whenever someone is involved in a pedestrian-car crash, time is often of the essence in the immediate aftermath. Beyond just calling 911 and seeking appropriate medical attention, though, filing suit in a timely fashion can also be crucial.

Every state imposes a statute of limitations that defines the time allotted to file a claim. In Georgia, there is a two-year statutory period for personal injury cases that begins the day of the accident, according to the Official Code of Georgia �9-3-33.

After experiencing a car accident as a pedestrian, it is understandable to want to move forward with your life. pages.content_md:
Property owners have a legal obligation to ensure that their premises is free of hazardous conditions. If a property owner does not comply with this standard, anyone who is hurt by these dangerous conditions while on their premises may have a claim for damages. A slippery floor, a broken elevator, falling debris, and inadequate security are all examples of hazards that can potentially form the basis of a premises liability lawsuit.

Consider contacting a Bremen premises liability lawyer if you believe you have a claim against a negligent property owner. Hiring a personal injury attorney who has experience with these cases can significantly increase your chances of recovering compensation for all of your losses.

Someone who gets hurt while visiting another person�s property must prove that they were legally negligent at the time fo their accident. A Bremen premises liability attorney could help an injured party present the necessary evidence to prove that they have a valid claim. A claimant can demonstrate a defendant�s negligence by showing that:

- A dangerous condition existed on the property
- The owner of the property either knew or should have known about the dangerous condition
- The owner failed to fix or remove the dangerous condition, or they did not warn visitors about it
- The dangerous condition caused harm to the claimant

There are many different ways that a dangerous condition can seriously harm a visitor. A Bremen property liability attorney could review a claim and identify the best course of legal action based on the cause of their injuries.

Slips, trips, and falls frequently result in viable property liability claims if an injured party can prove that a property owner failed to keep their premises free of tripping hazards. Slips may occur due to spilled liquids, cracked flooring, wrinkled carpeting, and uneven sidewalks.

A pet owner may face legal consequences under the doctrine of premises liability if they fail to control their animal who has dangerous propensities. It is important to note that someone may only be protected under this law if they were legally on the premises. Trespassers may not be able to claim damages if a dog attacks them while protecting their owner�s property.

Someone who suffered assault or another crime while on another�s property may have the option to sue if a property owner failed to provide adequate security. By not providing proper protection, the proprietor created a hazardous condition.

Swimming pools can be quite dangerous to adults and children alike if they not managed properly. A claimant should consult a lawyer if their injuries to inadequate lifeguard training, fencing, or poor signage.

This person also may be able to file a claim under the doctrine of attractive nuisance if a child is the one who was injured. State law imposes a duty on landowners to keep their properties free of attractive nuisances, such as swimming pools, that may cause harm to trespassing children.

An injury that was caused by dangerous conditions on someone else�s property may be compensable under state law. A Bremen premises liability lawyer could become your legal advocate throughout the claims process. To get started on your case, call today.

A Bremen slip and fall attorney could guide an injured party through the steps of filing a case depending on who is responsible for their accident and where it happened.

Especially in the winter when sidewalks may become slick due to ice and snow, property owners have a duty of care to ensure that visitors can walk safely in and out of their premises.

Another common cause of tripping accidents may include poor lighting, damaged stairs cases, and cluttered areas. A Bremen lawyer with experience in slip and fall cases could determine if a negligent property owner caused a claimant�s injuries.

If someone sustains injuries in a tripping accident, they should seek medical attention immediately, and if possible, they should take pictures of where their fall occurred. This could help an experienced attorney later on when they try to build a case.

If the incident occurred at work, an injured employee should speak with their supervisor. They would know the next steps in filing a workers� compensation claim.

One of the most important steps to take following a slip and fall accident is to contact a Breman attorney. They could protect a claimant�s right to compensation by working to ensure they file their case before the statute of limitations expires. pages.title: Bremen Truck Accident Lawyer | Damages and Liability
pages.description: Trucks can cause serious damage when a collision occurs. If you have been in a truck crash, make sure you contact a Bremen truck accident lawyer to see if you could get compensation.
pages.content_md:
Commercial trucks often tower over other cars on the road, delivering goods across the country day in and day out. While these trucks are indeed impressive from a technical perspective, their size and power can be terrifying when something goes wrong. Anyone who has ever experienced a truck accident could speak to the destructive force the vehicles can have.

Unlike the average collision between two passenger vehicles, liability is not always clear when trucks are involved. The truck driver, the company they work for, and even the manufacturer of the vehicle could all be held responsible for the damage done in a crash. If you are concerned about the fallout from your collision involving a tractor-trailer, call a Bremen truck accident lawyer as soon as possible to get experienced legal help with your case.

Truck collisions usually cause much more damage than crashes involving only cars. Compared to the average car or SUV on the road, tractor trailers are gigantic. Because of this size disparity, accidents involving passenger vehicles and trucks often cause considerable damage. Commuter cars generally sustain most of the damage in such accidents, as the size and weight of most commercial trucks make them incredibly powerful and able to withstand much more immense force than the average passenger vehicle.

Injuries stemming from truck accidents are often serious and sometimes deadly. In crashes where victims survive their injuries, the long-term impact of such an incident can be immense. Many accident victims suffer emotional damages like post-traumatic stress disorder, and treatment for both the physical and emotional pain caused by truck accidents can threaten a person�s finances and turn their world upside down.

Alabama law allows truck accident victims to pursue legal action when their crashes were caused by someone else�s negligence. However, determining fault in truck accidents is not always a simple matter.

It is often easy to point fingers at the truckers themselves, especially given the kind of stress they can be under. Truck drivers work long hours and often forgo breaks in order to make delivery deadlines. Many will find themselves driving while drowsy, which some experts argue is just as dangerous as driving under the influence of drugs or alcohol.

However, trucking companies and the manufacturers of the vehicles are often just as liable for truck collisions as truck drivers, if not more so. A Bremen truck accident attorney could help victims understand if their crash was caused by a sleepy or distracted driver or if the truck itself suffered a malfunction. By working to understand the exact chain of events that led to a collision, the plaintiff in a truck accident case can ensure they seek compensation from the appropriate liable parties.

The financial, emotional, and physical impacts of a motor vehicle accident are almost always difficult to manage, but incidents involving tractor trailers can be even more impactful. A Bremen truck accident lawyer could work to ensure their rights are protected and help you fight for the compensation you need for your damages.

Do not suffer in silence. Accidents happen, but when they are the result of human error, victims should not bear the burden of someone else�s mistake. Call today to schedule your confidential consultation with a compassionate and knowledgeable lawyer.

pages.title: Bremen Workers� Compensation Lawyer | Workplace Accident Claims

pages.content_md:
Workers� compensation is a form of insurance that provides financial assistance to injured employees as a means of helping them recover and promptly return to work. While some workers� comp claims are processed without incident, others may be unfairly delayed or denied.

Suffering a serious workplace injury may force you to take an extended leave of absence while you heal, and therefore, you may risk losing valuable income. Fortunately, a Bremen workers� compensation lawyer could offer assistance if you have been seriously injured in a workplace accident and cannot obtain benefits to make up for your lost income. A personal injury attorney could help you process your claim and work to ensure that you receive all the benefits you are entitled to under state law.

The state�s workers� comp system strikes a delicate balance between compensating those who have been seriously hurt at work and placing limits on how much money they can obtain for their injuries. A Bremen lawyer with experience in litigating workers� compensation claims could assess an injured employee�s losses and identify the types of benefits to which they may be entitled.

A hurt employee who cannot return to work for more than seven days may be eligible for temporary disability benefits. These equate to two-thirds of the employee�s average weekly wage prior to the injury, with a cap of $575 per week. The insurance company may pay a smaller amount to a hurt worker if they are able to return to work but not at their prior wage or salary level.

A permanent total injury � such as a complete loss of vision � may entitle someone to receive workers� comp benefits for life at a rate equal to their temporary disability benefits.

Permanent partial disability (PPD) benefits are available to those with some degree of permanent impairment, such as the loss of a finger. The amount and duration of PPD benefits are calculated based on a prescribed schedule.

An injured employee whose workers� compensation claim is denied has the right to appeal this decision. An insurance company may deny a claim for a variety of reasons, such as if the employee did not notify their employer of their injury in a timely manner, or if there is a dispute as to whether the injury is work-related. A Bremen workers� comp attorney could help an individual through the appellate process.

The first step in challenging a denied claim is to file a notice of claim using Form WC-14. The deadline to file a notice of claim differs depending on whether any medical treatment has already been provided, or if the insurance company has already made any disability payments. During mediation, a workers� compensation judicial officer may order the parties to seek an agreement.

If mediation is not successful, the injured worker and their attorney have the option of challenging the denial in a more formal workers� compensation hearing. The presiding judge should issue a ruling within 30 days. An unsatisfactory ruling of this hearing also may be appealed to the State Board of Workers� Compensation (SBWC). Appeals to the SBWC must adhere to strict filing deadlines.

A party that disputes a SBWC ruling could file an appeal in the state�s civil justice system. Such an appeal must be filed in the county where the worker�s injury allegedly occurred, and within 20 days of the SBWC�s final order.

You do not have to navigate the workers� comp system alone if you sustained a serious workplace injury. A Bremen workers� compensation lawyer could guide you through the claims process and work to ensure that you obtain fair payments. For assistance on your claim, schedule an appointment with an attorney today.

pages.title: Bremen Wrongful Death Lawyer | Fatal Accident Claims

If you lost a loved one due to another person�s negligence, you have the right to hold them accountable for their reckless and careless actions. By speaking with a Bremen wrongful death lawyer, you could receive the emotional and legal support you need when pursuing a claim of this kind. A compassionate personal injury attorney could seek justice for your loved one while you and your family members focus on grieving your loss.

Wrongful death cases share some similarities to personal injury claims. While both entail seeking damages for a plaintiff�s losses, a wrongful death claim involves the decedent’s family members bringing a lawsuit to court on behalf of the plaintiff who is unable to do so themselves. A wrongful death claim may only be viable if the deceased could have filed a civil suit had they survived their accident.

Some accidents that may cause viable wrongful death claims may include birth injuries, instances of medical malpractice, and motor vehicle collisions. A Bremen wrongful death attorney could assist a claimant in determining if they have a viable claim and who may be at fault.

Official Code of Georgia Annotated �51-4-2, establishes who may file a wrongful death claim depending on the circumstances of the deceased surviving family members. State law allows for the spouse of the decedent to have the option to file a lawsuit first. If the deceased did not have a spouse, then surviving children may file a claim to collect damages. The laws surrounding who may file a claim can become complex depending on the situation. Therefore, a potential claimant should speak with a Bremen lawyer who has experience litigating wrongful death case before moving forward with legal action.

The relationship that the claimant had to the deceased may impact their compensation. For instance, if the individual filing a claim on behalf of the deceased was their spouse or child, they may be entitled to the full value of the life of the deceased. This means that the spouse or children may obtain monetary compensation, such as their expected employee wages or benefits.

When the estate executor is the claimant, they may only acquire damages for medical bills, funeral expenses, and the emotional pain and suffering the deceased experienced before dying. A wrongful death lawyer in Bremen could review a case and evaluate the damages to which the claimant may be entitled.

The shock of losing a family member could leave you feeling lost and overwhelmed. Fortunately, a Bremen wrongful death lawyer could guide you through the legal process if you recently lost a loved one in an accident caused by the reckless actions of another.

You and your family member deserve closure, and a dedicated attorney could help. To start the legal process, call today and schedule an initial case consultation.

pages.content_md:
# Bremen’s Road Work Is Picking Up—Here’s How to Drive Safely While Streets Are Being Paved

 Posted on - Friday, June 20, 2025 under General, Safety Tips If you live in Bremen, you’ve probably seen the signs—or the road crews themselves. The city recently

opened bids for a large street paving project to upgrade several local roads. It’s a much-needed

improvement, but if you’re behind the wheel while it’s going on, you’ll need to take some extra

precautions.

Fresh pavement, loose gravel, and large construction vehicles can turn an everyday drive into a

dangerous one if you’re not paying close attention. We’ve seen plenty of accidents happen in exactly

these kinds of conditions.

### How to Stay Safe While Bremen Streets Get Repaved

- Watch for detours and signs.
 It’s tempting to just follow your usual route, but if a road is closed or being worked on, don’t force it. Respect the detours and stay out of closed zones—even if it looks passable.
- Take it slow on fresh asphalt.
 New pavement can be slick, especially when it’s still settling or hasn’t been fully marked. Go slower than usual and be careful with turns and sudden stops.
- Be extra careful around construction trucks.
 They’re big, loud, and not as nimble as your car. Give them space to move, especially when backing up or turning. Don’t try to pass a paving crew unless you’re absolutely sure it’s safe and legal to do so.
- Expect the unexpected.
 In paving zones, lanes might shift, markings might be missing, and loose gravel could pop up out of
 nowhere. Assume the road might not behave the way it usually does.
- Don’t assume it’s your fault if there’s an accident.
 If you’re involved in a crash in or near a paving zone, don’t rush to take the blame. There could be other factors at play—like missing signs, dangerous drop-offs, or mismanaged traffic patterns.

### We’ve Helped Others—We Can Help You

Construction-related accidents can be tricky. Was the city responsible? The paving company? Another

driver? These are the kinds of questions we know how to answer. If you or someone you love was hurt

in a paving zone crash, talk to Parian Lawyers. We’re based right here in West Georgia and we

understand how to deal with these local situations.

pages.title: Can I Still Recover Damages If I Was Partially at Fault in a Georgia Car Accident? - Parian Lawyers
pages.h1: Can I Still Recover Damages If I Was Partially at Fault in a Georgia Car Accident?
pages.content_md:
Many people involved in car accidents in Georgia walk away wondering if they still have a case

if they were partially to blame. Whether it was a missed turn signal, speeding slightly, or being

distracted by a phone, it’s common for drivers to share some degree of responsibility. The good

news is that Georgia law allows injured victims to recover damages even if they were partly at

fault for the crash.

Under Georgia’s modified comparative negligence rule, you can still receive compensation as

long as you are less than 50% responsible for the accident. This means that even if you made a

mistake behind the wheel, you may still be entitled to recover money for medical expenses, lost

income, vehicle repairs, and pain and suffering.

However, your compensation will be reduced by your percentage of fault. For example, if you

are found to be 20% responsible for the accident and your damages total $100,000, you would

still be eligible to receive $80,000. This legal structure makes it crucial to have a knowledgeable

car accident attorney on your side to argue your case and ensure the insurance companies

don’t unfairly shift more blame onto you than is appropriate.

At Parian Lawyers, we have extensive experience handling car accident cases throughout West

Georgia, including Carrollton, Douglasville, and along the I-20 corridor. We know how to

analyze accident reports, gather witness statements, and work with experts to build a strong

case that accurately reflects what happened. If you believe you may be partially at fault in a

recent accident, don’t assume you’re out of options.

Let our team review the details and guide you on the best path forward. Even if fault is shared,

your right to fair compensation remains. Contact Parian Lawyers today for a free consultation

with a car accident lawyer who understands Georgia’s complex laws and will fight to protect

your rights.

pages.content_md:
# Adult Adoptions in Carrollton

Adoption, in general, is some of the most fulfilling and satisfying work a lawyer can do. Having the ability to guide parents through the process of adopting someone they will love and care for unconditionally is a wonderful feeling. When thinking of adoption, many people fail to realize that it is not only children who seek adoption, but also adults who desire to have their existing bond with a parental figure solidified recognized the law. Our firm has the experience you need to help in adult adoptions in Carrollton.

## The Process of Adult Adoption

Georgia is one of many states who recognize adult adoptions and provides for a streamlined process. In Georgia, adults who wish to be adopted need to provide written consent to be adopted and the petitioner should file their petition. The petition and consent can be filed in the county where the petitioner resides or where the adoptee resides. Once filed, the court will set a date for a final hearing and, barring the court finding a reason such adoption should not be granted, will enter a final decree. The party seeking to be adopted can also petition the court enter an order changing their name as well. Our firm�s attorneys could guide you through every step of the adult adoption process in Carrollton.

## The Change of Relationship under the Law

Once the decree of adoption is entered, the relation between the petitioner and adopted adult is the same under the law as if the adopted adult was the biological child of the petitioner. Many times, adult adoptions occur in situations regarding godparents and godchildren, or stepparents and stepchildren, but there are other instances where adult adoption may be pursued. However, there are instances where adult adoption is sought for nefarious purposes. It is important to contact our law firm to help guide you and your loved ones through this process. Our experience as well as relationships with court personnel will help provide you with the smooth process you deserve and need for the adoption of an adult in Carrollton.

pages.content_md:
Passenger vans or buses can be used in a variety of capacities. Still, many of these vehicles have several safety concerns and can be some of the most dangerous passenger vehicles on the roads and interstates.

With that said, if you have suffered injuries in a wreck with one of these types of vehicles, you should seek the counsel of a Carrollton bus accident lawyer. With a high center of gravity, passenger vans commonly�rollover�when involved in motor vehicle accidents. The reason for these rollovers is that many bus drivers have a poor understanding of the maneuverability of these vehicles. They simply do not drive like other passenger vehicles.

The mere fact that an injury occurs after a bus accident does not mean that the driver was at fault. All plaintiffs bear the burden of proving that bus driver negligence was the cause of their losses.

In many cases, plaintiffs must establish negligence by showing that the bus driver violated a certain traffic law. This may involve speeding, tailgating, or failing to signal or yield when required. A Carrollton attorney could follow an accident case through traffic court to determine if a bus driver was liable for a traffic code violation.

However, other cases do not involve tickets. In these situations, a plaintiff needs to show that simple carelessness led to the collision. An attorney can talk to witnesses, gather traffic camera footage, and speak with accident reconstructionists to determine who may be at fault.

Statute of Limitations in Carrollton

No matter how severe a person�s injuries may be following a bus crash, they have only a limited time to seek compensation. This applies equally to claims that run through insurance companies and cases that go to trial.

According to Official Code of Georgia Annotated �9-3-33, plaintiffs must file a claim for damages within two years of the date of their accident. However, there are a few exceptions to this rule. For instance, if a wreck involves a city bus or school bus, the statute of limitations may be even shorter. A Carrollton lawyer could help a plaintiff file their bus accident case on time.

What Damages Could a Bus Accident Claimant Seek?

After a collision, a negligent bus driver and their employer may be liable to provide payments that cover all resulting damage. In many of these claims, the plaintiff may demand compensation for both past and future medical costs associated with their subsequent injuries.

However, individuals likely may suffer more than physical damage. For instance, a claimant may sustain emotional losses such as pain and suffering in addition to property damage. At-fault defendants may be liable to provide payments for these losses as well.

Additionally, defendants must provide reimbursement for all lost earnings. These include hours missed to seek treatment and any lost income due to permanent injury. An attorney in Carrollton could help someone pursue claims for proper payments after a bus wreck.

Contact Our Carrollton Bus Accident Attorneys
