pages.h1: Riverdale Failure to Yield Accident Lawyer
pages.content_md:
Failure to yield accidents can happen on when someone is entering or exiting the highway, navigating in parking lots, and driving where two streets merge into one. If you become injured in this kind of collision, establishing fault can be challenging without a skilled car accident attorney.

A diligent Riverdale failure to yield accident lawyer could assist in pursuing compensation for your injuries by showing a jury that the crash may have been avoidable if not for the other driver�s negligence.

Drivers must understand and comply with the rules regarding the right of way to avoid getting into dangerous collisions. While there is no single law that sets out the right of way in any given situation, the Official Code of Georgia �40-6-73 establishes a loose framework that states that a driver entering the roadway must yield to approaching vehicles on the road before entering traffic.

While some right of way rules may be intuitive, it is common for distracted drivers to cause a collision by failing to yield to oncoming traffic. When a driver�s negligence causes a collision, a seasoned failure to yield accident lawyer in Riverdale could assist an injured claimant pursue compensation for damages from the responsible party.

Proving that a driver failed to yield to oncoming traffic may not be enough to require compensation. An accident victim in a T-bone case must also show that the defendant�s negligence was the cause of the accident. A knowledgeable attorney with experience handling failure to yield accident cases may assist someone in establishing negligence by helping an accident victim collect the necessary evidence.

The injured plaintiff�s Riverdale failure to yield accident attorney must prove that the defendant owed them a duty of care to receive compensation at trial. All drivers owe others on the road a duty to operate their motor vehicles safely by abiding all traffic regulations, including giving the right of way when necessary.

The plaintiff�s attorney also must show that the defendant violated their duty by failing to yield on a roadway or in a parking lot. If they can establish the defendant violated traffic laws, the jury may consider this evidence of a breach of the defendant�s duty.

To obtain compensation, the plaintiff�s failure to yield collision attorney must prove that they suffered damages. These damages could include medical bills, time away from work, or pain and suffering. The damages that the plaintiff experienced must have been a direct result of their accident.

If you or a loved one were injured due to a negligent motorist, contact an experienced Riverdale failure to yield accident lawyer right away to discuss your legal options. They can review your case and help you through any legal obstacles while you focus on your recovery. To begin the process of recovering damages for your injuries, schedule an initial case consultation with an attorney today.

pages.title: Riverdale Rollover Car Accident Lawyer | Tipped Over Car Wreck
pages.description: An experienced Riverdale rollover car accident lawyer could help you recover compensation if you were injured in rollover collision. Call today.
pages.content_md:
Vehicle crashes can be traumatic under any circumstance. However, if you are involved in a rollover collision, the potential for severe injuries can increase dramatically. Rollover crashes can be one of the most dangerous types of collisions because they can cause long-term injuries and fatalities.

If you or a loved one sustained injuries in a rollover accident, a seasoned car wreck attorney could help you recover compensation for your injuries and damages. To learn how to hold the driver responsible for your injuries accountable, contact a Riverdale rollover car accident lawyer.

Rollover auto accidents can occur when several factors come together at the wrong moment. The following factors may have an impact on whether a collision results in a vehicle rolling over:

- Vehicle type: some vehicles that are top-heavy, such as SUVs and pickup trucks, may be more prone to rollovers than others.
- Impact location: when another vehicle strikes a car on its side, the probability of a rollover may increase.
- Speed: the faster that a vehicle is traveling when it crashes into another car, the more likely that both vehicles may roll over and cause fatal injuries.
- Location: rural roads may result in more rollover collisions because they can lack barriers or divided lanes.

When reviewing an injury claim, an experienced Riverdale rollover car accident attorney considers every factor that may have led to the crash to build a thorough case.

Monetary compensation may only be available to a plaintiff in a rollover accident lawsuit if they can establish damages. If a plaintiff did not suffer damages, or if the injuries were not related to the rollover crash, they may not have a viable claim against the defendant.

Damages can result from any injury caused by the wreck, which may include monetary losses, psychological harm, and bodily injury. One of the roles of a Riverdale rollover collision lawyer may be to identify the damages potentially available to an injured party based on their losses.

Civil lawsuits often result in the plaintiff receiving economic damages, which are quantified by any monetary expenses that an injured party has as a result of their injuries. Some common examples of economic damages in a rollover lawsuit may include medical expenses, vehicle repair costs, and lost wages.

An accident victim may also be subject to non-economic damages, which may not be as easily quantifiable. Non-economic damages should compensate a plaintiff for subjective losses. Some examples of non-economic damages may include:

- Pain and suffering
- Loss of consortium
- Mental anguish
- Loss of companionship

A seasoned attorney could evaluate the plaintiff�s losses and help them recover compensation that covers the full value of their damages.

The potential injuries in a rollover car crash can be so significant that they can lead to permanent injury or death. If you have suffered severe injuries in a rollover collision, the party responsible for the crash may be held liable for damages. You may be eligible to recover compensation for your damages.

With the help of a skilled Riverdale rollover car accident lawyer, you can focus on your recovery while they handle the challenges that come with filing your claim. To get started on your case, call today for an initial consultation.

pages.title: Riverdale Uber/Taxi Accident Lawyer | Lyft Car Collisions
pages.description: If you were injured in a wreck with an Uber, Lyft, or taxi driver, contact an experienced Riverdale Uber/taxi accident lawyer today.
pages.content_md:
It can be challenging to know what steps to take when you suffer injuries as a passenger on a taxi or Uber ride. While some people have a good understanding of how their insurance can protect them in the event of a collision, few may be aware of how liability insurance works in these situations. A well-practiced car wreck attorney could provide you with additional information if you get hurt in an Uber or taxi accident.

You do not have to go through this complex litigation process on your own. It is best to speak to a Riverdale Uber/taxi accident lawyer to discuss your legal rights and options.

A plaintiff in a taxi or Uber accident lawsuit may have the option to seek compensation from the negligent driver. However, it may be unclear as to who must ultimately pay these damages to the injured plaintiff because there may be a patchwork of insurance policies that could come into play. A well-versed Riverdale Uber/taxi accident attorney may review an injured plaintiff�s case and determine who may be responsible for paying compensation based on the facts of the case.

In wrecks involving taxi cabs, the most common source of compensation may be the insurance company or the taxi company. A taxi company usually provides insurance coverage for their taxis and if one of their drivers gets into an accident while on the job.

While there is extensive case law on taxi cab accidents, the law surrounding rideshare companies is still developing. In previous cases, the primary sources of compensation have been from insurance companies.

Uber drivers are required to carry their own liability insurance similar to any other driver on the road. These policies must provide coverage for at least $25,000 per bodily injury per person, $50,000 for bodily injuries per accident, and $25,000 in property damage.

Uber, however, also insures their drivers from the moment they accept a trip until its conclusion. These policies carry up to $1,000,000 in liability coverage and an additional $1,000,000 to cover for uninsured motorists. These large policies may provide coverage regardless of whether the Uber driver was at fault. It is important to mention that if an Uber driver is between rides at the time of a crash, company insurance may not cover any damages.

A plaintiff does not have an unlimited window to file a lawsuit resulting from an Uber/taxi accident. The statute of limitations prevents an injured victim from filing a lawsuit after a certain deadline. For personal injury lawsuits, the statute of limitations is two years from the date of the accident.

If a plaintiff files a lawsuit after that deadline, the court has the right to dismiss the case. An experienced uber/taxi collision lawyer in Riverdale could work to ensure that a plaintiff meets all statutory deadlines and does not risk their chance at compensation. Therefore, it is crucial to reach out to a dedicated lawyer as soon as possible after a crash.

Resolving an injury claim with an Uber or taxi driver can be confusing without a legal professional. Fortunately, you do not have to take these companies on by yourself. To learn more about the benefits of hiring a Riverdale Uber/taxi accident lawyer, call to schedule an initial case consultation.

pages.title: Riverdale Uninsured Car Accident Lawyer | Underinsured Car Wreck
pages.description: If you were involved in a car wreck with an uninsured or underinsured driver, reach out to a Riverdale uninsured car accident lawyer.
pages.content_md:
Uninsured drivers are not only in violation of state law, but they also may be putting other drivers at risk. If you or a loved one were injured due to an uninsured motor vehicle driver, a knowledgeable car wreck attorney could help you hold them accountable through litigation.

With help from a Riverdale uninsured car accident lawyer, you may be eligible to recover compensation for your injuries and damages.

Every driver that operates a motor vehicle is required to carry auto liability insurance. The goal of widespread coverage is to ensure that negligent drivers can compensate their victims for their injuries. The minimum requirements for insurance coverage in Georgia are known as 25/50/25. Every vehicle must carry liability insurance with at least $25,000 in coverage for bodily injuries per person, $50,000 in bodily injury coverage per accident, and $25,000 in property damages.

For minor collisions, this coverage may be adequate. However, in a severe crash, medical bills can exceed $25,000. If an injured victim�s damages are more than the coverage limits of the negligent driver�s policy, the insurance company is only responsible for their policy limits. A plaintiff may still be able to pursue the negligent driver personally for any remaining damages with assistance from a Riverdale uninsured car accident attorney.

If an injured driver does not have comprehensive insurance to cover the damages they suffered in a crash, there may be other potential sources that a Riverdale uninsured car wreck lawyer could uncover.

The negligent driver�s insurance company may be able to pay the full value of a plaintiff�s claim if their car accident attorney can prove that the other driver�s careless behavior caused their losses. However, obtaining compensation from the defendant�s insurance company may be complicated when a plaintiff�s injuries exceed the amount of coverage available. These companies may defend the person they are insuring by negotiating with the plaintiff to reduce their compensation to the defendant�s policy limit or getting the defendant to agree to pay the remaining balance.

A plaintiff has the right to seek damages directly from the negligent driver. If the driver has significant assets, they may be able to pay the plaintiff�s entire claim. However, if the negligent driver has limited resources, it could be difficult to collect on those damages even if the plaintiff obtains a judgment.

If a driver has an uninsured motorist policy, they have the right to file a claim with their own insurance company. This is a secondary policy that only applies once other policies are exhausted. It may be worth it to most drivers to have a strong uninsured motorist policy in addition to their other liability coverage. For more information, consult with an experienced lawyer.

Getting into a wreck with an uninsured motorist can come with many legal obstacles. Let a seasoned attorney help you hold the party responsible for your accident accountable for their actions. A Riverdale uninsured car accident lawyer could review your claim and guide you through the complex legal process.

Schedule a consultation today.

pages.title: Riverdale Catastrophic Injury Lawyer | Permanent Injuries
pages.description: If you experienced severe harm due to the negligence of another, contact a Riverdale catastrophic injury lawyer to discuss your legal options.
pages.content_md:
When someone experiences a catastrophic injury, the harm that results can be so severe that the consequences of their injury last for a lifetime. Typically, these injuries result in scarring, disfigurement, or the loss of function in a part of the body. Fortunately, if the negligence of another was the cause of a catastrophic injury, a seasoned personal injury attorney might be able to help the victim recover compensation from the person responsible.

If you have suffered a severe injury, you deserve to hold the negligent party accountable for your losses. A Riverdale catastrophic injury lawyer could help you get started on your claim and work toward the closure you deserve.

To succeed in a catastrophic injury lawsuit, a plaintiff must prove that the defendant acted negligently when the accident occurred. To prove negligence, a plaintiff must demonstrate the following four elements:

- The defendant owes a duty of care to the plaintiff
- The defendant breached that duty of care
- The breach caused the plaintiff�s damages
- The plaintiff suffered real damages

A Riverdale catastrophic injury attorney might be able to prove negligence in several ways. For instance, they may call eyewitnesses or introduce video evidence that demonstrates how a defendant breached the duty they owed to the plaintiff.

Alternatively or additionally, a legal representative may also provide medical records or expert testimony as proof of damages. It is important to note that proving negligence can be difficult without assistance from a legal professional, so it is encouraged to speak with a lawyer before filing a catastrophic injury claim.

While many catastrophic injury cases settle out of court, the cases that ultimately go to trial follow a similar litigative path. An injury lawsuit begins when the plaintiff files a complaint�a legal document which outlines the allegations as well as the damages sought. Once a plaintiff files a complaint, they must serve a copy of it to the defendant, providing them formal notice that they have been sued and giving them an opportunity to seek the legal representation of their own. In most cases, the defendant files a document that responds to each of the plaintiff�s allegations.

The next stage is the discovery phase, during which both sides review the evidence the other side plans on offering at trial. While discovery often involves written requests, it also may include in-person questioning through the deposition process. Some cases may settle soon after discovery phase comes to an end, but if the case continues, both parties conduct pre-trial motions. Some attorneys file motions early on in the case, while others may be heard shortly before trial. Motion practice frequently narrows the issues heard at trial, but it can also expedite the end of a lawsuit.

Once the parties resolve discovery and any outstanding motions, the trial begins. The plaintiff�s attorney gives their opening statement, and the defense lawyer follows. Once the jury hears all the evidence, they retire to reach a verdict. The civil litigation process can be challenging, especially when a plaintiff�s injuries are severe. An experienced catastrophic injury lawyer in Riverdale could guide an injured victim during this daunting process and advise them through the end of their case.

When you experience severe trauma, it can be challenging to balance recovery with the other pressures that come with navigating the legal process. Fortunately, a skilled Riverdale catastrophic injury lawyer could take some of this weight off of your shoulders.

An attorney can investigate the accident and build a strong case while you focus on recovery. Call today to learn more about how legal counsel could help you.

pages.title: Riverdale Burn Injury Lawyer | Fire Injuries | Chemical Burns
pages.description: If you were seriously burned due to the negligence of another, contact a Riverdale burn injury lawyer to discuss your legal options.
pages.content_md:
If you have suffered a severe burn injury, you may be suffering complications unlike any others you have experienced in different accidents. Burns can lead to severe scarring and disfigurement, as well as other permanent conditions like nerve damage.

If the negligence of another person causes you to suffer burn injuries, you may have the option of pursuing monetary damages. A seasoned Riverdale burn injury lawyer could help you build your case and seek the compensation to which you may be entitled. Success in a burn injury lawsuit can be challenging without the help of a skilled catastrophic injury attorney. Call today to learn how legal counsel could help you.

Medical professionals categorize burn injuries by their severity. While less severe burns typically do not result in permanent damage, the most complicated burn injuries typically include lifelong effects.

The four classifications of burn injuries are first-degree, second-degree, third-degree, and fourth-degree burns. Depending on the classification of someone�s burn injuries and the cause, they may need to speak with a Riverdale burn injury attorney to discuss their legal options for compensation.

A first-degree burn is the least severe category of burn injuries. These burns typically do not extend beyond the exterior layer of skin, and the effects of these burns rarely involve more than a few days of discomfort.

Second-degree burns are more serious than first-degree burns. A second-degree burn may damage both the first and second layer of skin and can result in blisters and redness.

The second most severe type of burn injury is a third-degree burn. Third-degree burns damage several deeper layers of skin and can even char the outermost layer. These burns can destroy the nerve endings in the skin and could lead to severe pain and discomfort.

The most severe category of burn injuries is fourth-degree burns. Fourth-degree burns can destroy entire layers of skin and can damage the muscle beneath, and are often ultimately fatal to victims.

While it can be costly to recover from any injury, burns can have long-term effects that are not immediately visible and which could lead to years of increased medical expenses. For instance, along with the pain, scarring, and disfigurement that may come with a burn injury, there is also the possibility of severe nerve damage that may eventually turn into severe chronic pain. Other problems that can lead to an increase in healthcare costs include the risk of infection, treatment for smoke inhalation, and joint damage.

Even though many health issues that stem from a burn injury are not immediately noticeable, it is possible for a victim to recover compensation. A plaintiff in a burn injury lawsuit may seek damages for past medical bills as well as future potential medical costs. A Riverdale lawyer with experience in burn injury cases could help a burn victim fight for potential future medical expenses in addition to their initial losses. A seasoned attorney could help injured victims file a claim promptly.

Experienced, reliable legal counsel could make all the difference in your burn injury lawsuit. Burn injury cases are unlike any other type of lawsuit, and a deep understanding of how burns can affect the body could significantly impact how much compensation you may be entitled to. To learn how a Riverdale burn injury lawyer might help you recover damages on your claim, call today to schedule a consultation.

pages.title: Riverdale Paralysis Injury Lawyer | Paraplegia and Quadriplegia
pages.description: If you or a loved one suffered a paralyzing injury, contact a Riverdale paralysis injury lawyer to discuss your legal options.
pages.content_md:
Living with a paralysis injury can impact your life in many ways. Tasks you once completed without much thought can become significant obstacles, and in addition to the physical toll, a paralysis injury can create financial obstacles as well.

A skilled catastrophic injury attorney may be able to help you recover damages from the person responsible for your injury. While this process to pursue compensation may seem daunting, an experienced Riverdale paralysis injury lawyer could help make civil litigation more manageable.

Paralysis is defined as the loss of the movement or control over parts of the body and most commonly occurs due to head or neck injuries. Depending on the type of trauma to the body, a paralysis injury can be either temporary or permanent. Severe injuries typically result in life-long paralysis.

While severe impact injuries may result in immediate paralysis, it can occur gradually in other cases. Paralysis can begin with numbness or a tingling sensation in the hand or foot and slowly develop into a loss of feeling and control in that entire part of the body.

Medical professionals categorize paralysis injuries into four different forms of trauma, depending on the part of the body it affects. The types of paralysis include:

- Monoplegia � paralysis in one limb
- Hemiplegia � paralysis on one side of the body
- Paraplegia � paralysis in both legs
- Quadriplegia � paralysis from the neck down.

For more information, consult with a knowledgeable lawyer.

While the health and welfare of any injury victim are paramount, it is worth noting the enormous expenses related to a paralysis injury. The costs associated with an emergency room visit and initial hospital stay are often high, but medical costs also can increase even further as a paralysis victim gets older.

Medical costs can go beyond treatment and hospital care. Other costs related to paralysis injuries may include:

- Home remodeling
- Wheelchairs or mobility scooters
- Physical therapy
- Lost wages
- Medical devices

When another person�s negligent acts are the cause of a paralysis injury, the injury victim might be able to recover monetary damages that cover these costs along with others. A seasoned Riverdale paralysis injury attorney could review an injured victim�s case to identify what types of damages they may be eligible to pursue based on the specifics of their situation.

To recover monetary compensation for their injuries, a victim must file their lawsuit before the statutory deadline. The statute of limitations for personal injury lawsuits establishes a deadline of two years from the day of the accident. In cases involving a government entity, a plaintiff only has six months from the date of the incident to file suit.

If a plaintiff files a lawsuit after the statute has expired, the court may dismiss the injury case permanently. A diligent paralysis injury lawyer in Riverdale could help ensure that a paralysis victim files their claim efficiently and within the statutory time frame.

If you are seeking damages from the party responsible for your injury, you do not have to go through the litigation process alone. The burdens associated with pursuing a personal injury claim can be enormous, but a Riverdale paralysis lawyer could help lift some of these concerns off your shoulders. Call today to schedule a consultation and discuss your legal options.

pages.title: Riverdale Spinal Cord Injury Lawyer | Back Trauma
pages.description: If you are suffering a back injury, contact a Riverdale spinal cord injury lawyer to discuss your options for compensation from the negligent party.
pages.content_md:
If you have suffered a spinal cord injury, the impact on your day-to-day life can be severe, and in some cases even permanent. As a result, you could be facing rising medical bills that you cannot afford.

Fortunately, you may be entitled to monetary compensation if your injury was caused by the negligence of another person. A skilled catastrophic injury attorney may be able to help you recover the compensation you need to live comfortably with your injury for the rest of your life.

Obtaining compensation for your injuries can be challenging, though, as a spinal injury claim requires a thorough understanding of both the law and the human body. A knowledgeable Riverdale spinal cord injury lawyer may have the skill set necessary to help you pursue a positive outcome in your case.

The spinal cord is a lengthy bundle of nerves running from the brain to the base of the spine that transmits commands from the brain to the rest of the body. These nerves are extremely susceptible to injury, and the consequences of trauma to the spinal cord can last a lifetime. In a worst-case scenario, a spinal cord injury can leave a victim paralyzed.

When a spinal cord injury results from the negligence of another person, the injury victim has the right to pursue monetary compensation. Damages come in two distinct categories: economic damages and noneconomic damages. Economic damages are simple to quantify and may include medical bills, lost wages, and future healthcare costs.

Noneconomic damages, on the other hand, are intangible losses that are more difficult to measure. Common non-economic damages may include pain and suffering, decreased future earning potential, and disfigurement. Depending on the specifics of a case, a Riverdale spinal cord injury attorney could help an injured victim pursue compensation for one or both types of losses.

Determining the party responsible for an accident can be complex. For instance, in some cases, a court may find that multiple parties share responsibility, including the victim. A plaintiff that is partially responsible for their own injury may still recover damages according to Georgia�s modified contributory negligence law, but the court may reduce their compensation in proportion to the percentage they are found to be at fault for the accident.

However, this situation may only occur if the court finds the plaintiff 49 percent or less at fault for their injuries. If a plaintiff is 50 percent or more at fault, the court may bar them from recovering anything. A Riverdale lawyer with experience in spinal cord injury lawsuits could review a victim�s case to evaluate the maximum amount of damages they may be able to receive based on their unique circumstances.

No one deserves to face the consequences of a permanent spinal cord injury alone. If you experienced severe trauma to your spine due to someone else�s careless or reckless behavior, a Riverdale spinal cord injury lawyer could help you pursue compensation for your injuries. Call today to set up an initial consultation.

pages.title: Riverdale Traumatic Brain Injury Lawyer | Head Trauma | TBI
pages.description: If you are suffering head trauma after an accident, contact a Riverdale traumatic brain injury lawyer to discuss your legal options.
pages.content_md:
The brain is the epicenter of the human body and is vital for daily functions, so when the brain suffers an injury, it can impact not only a victim�s mental abilities but their physical capabilities as well. If you have suffered a traumatic brain injury, a skilled catastrophic injury attorney may be able to help you pursue monetary compensation for any of the losses that you may face.

Treating a traumatic brain injury can come at a high cost, so it is usually in your best interest to pursue as much in civil damages as possible. Once you hire a Riverdale traumatic brain injury lawyer, they could help you fight for the optimal compensation that you deserve.

Traumatic brain injuries (TBIs) typically result from an extreme impact to the head. While blows to the head can cause visible cuts or bruising, TBIs are often undetectable immediately after the injury occurs. Due to the lack of visible damage, a victim could be unaware of the severity of their injuries for extended periods of time.

Likewise, symptoms related to severe brain injuries can be difficult to detect and can range from emotional responses to physical ailments. Many of these symptoms also may seem unrelated to each other, which is another factor that can make diagnosing a brain injury difficult. Common signs of a traumatic brain injury may include:

- Vomiting
- Headaches
- Emotional outbursts
- Dizziness
- Loss of feeling
- Dilated pupils
- Seizures

A Riverdale traumatic brain injury attorney could review a TBI victim�s case to determine what kinds of damages they may be entitled to based on the symptoms they experience and the severity of their injury. More symptoms may indicate a more serious TBI, and accordingly a higher potential for monetary recovery.

In the worst-case scenario, brain injuries are permanent. However, there have been several scientific breakthroughs that have successfully treated symptoms of certain traumatic brain injuries.

In some cases, physical therapy can assist an injury victim in recovering lost motor skills. Therapy can take years, however, and there is no guarantee of success. In other cases, surgery may relieve some issues relating to brain trauma.

Treating these injuries comes at a real financial cost and can last a lifetime. When a traumatic brain injury results from the negligence of another person, the cost of these recovery options could be factored into a personal injury lawsuit. Fortunately, a compassionate lawyer could help a victim recover from their injuries.

Georgia state law sets out a timeframe in which an injured victim must file a potential civil lawsuit. For a traumatic brain injury claim, the period set by the statute of limitations is two years from the date of the injury.

Any suit filed after the expiration of this deadline may be dismissed, meaning the claimant would lose their ability to obtain compensation for their injuries. A potential benefit of hiring a traumatic brain injury lawyer in Riverdale is their ability to ensure that all legal deadlines are met.

If you are concerned about how a lawsuit may impact your life, do not be afraid to ask for help. An experienced Riverside traumatic brain injury lawyer could help you navigate through the complex legal process while you focus on recovery. Call today to set up a consultation about your case.

pages.title: Riverdale Dangerous Drugs Lawyer | Harmful Medication
pages.description: If you have suffered adverse side effects from medication, contact a Riverdale dangerous drugs lawyer to discuss your options to take legal action.
pages.content_md:
Americans rely on all sorts of over-the-counter and prescription drugs as well as nutritional and herbal supplements to help them live healthy lives. Whether it is medications to combat an infection, control a heart condition, relieve pain or anything in between, consumers trust that these medications would help them and not cause them harm. However, there are times where that trust is misplaced and a dangerous drug is placed into the market for sale. When this happens, victims may want to retain the services of a legal representative.

If you were harmed by taking a medication, it is time to explore your legal options with an experienced Riverdale dangerous drugs lawyer.

When drug companies place profits over the safety of their patients, that decision could lead to disastrous and even deadly consequences for helpless consumers. Dangerous drugs are medications that are brought to the market and made available for consumers but could cause severe side effects due to improper research or pharmaceutical negligence.

These drugs often come without any type of warning. Under the Code of Federal Regulations 201.56 and 201.57, drug manufacturers are required to label their products with certain facts about the drug, including any warnings that consumers should be aware of. This law applies to both over-the-counter and prescription drugs.

Sometimes the drug in question has not been through enough testing to determine its safety as is sometimes the case with drugs that are allowed to be on the market under the 510(k) premarket program. With this program, pharmaceuticals could introduce medication to the market without full testing if a similar drug is already on the market. However, doing so could warrant liability.

A Riverdale dangerous drugs attorney could represent patients who have been harmed by dangerous drugs. Victims may be owed money by the drug manufacturers. Examples of some recent dangerous drugs include:

- Fluoroquinolone antibiotics
- Taxotere
- Prempro
- Low testosterone therapy
- Zofran
- Xarelto and Pradaxa
- Opioids
- Proton pump inhibitors

Residents of Georgia have a two-year statute of limitations under the Official Code of Georgia Annotated �9-3-33. The statute of limitations is in place to keep lawsuits based on recent evidence. Plaintiff�s or their dangerous drugs lawyer in Riverdale must file their case no later than two years after sustaining their dangerous drugs injury.

After the two-years passes, a plaintiff could still file their lawsuit. However, there is little chance that their case would be successful as the defendant may likely ask the judge to throw the case out since the statute of limitations has expired. Often, the judge has no choice but to comply, and the victim then loses their right to seek compensation for this injury from the defendant.

If you or someone you love has sustained injuries from any of these dangerous drugs or others, you could benefit from consulting with a knowledgeable Riverdale dangerous drugs lawyer as soon as possible. Because time is of the essence, you may need to seek help sooner rather than later. Schedule your legal consultation today to get your dangerous drugs case started.

pages.title: Riverdale Defective Products Lawyer | Faulty Items Claim
pages.description: If you have been injured by a faulty product, reach out to a Riverdale defective products lawyer to discuss your options for compensation.
pages.content_md:
When you purchase a product, you likely trust that it works as intended. You consider it to be safe since it is on the market for consumer use. Unfortunately, many consumers still suffer injuries because of poorly manufactured products. If you have been harmed by a defective product, contacting an accomplished attorney could be the first step toward recovery.

Whether it was a kitchen appliance, a car part, a hairdryer, a television, or anything in between that caused you harm, a Riverdale defective products lawyer could hold a manufacturer liable for the injuries their product caused.

Georgia law recognizes that its residents could suffer injury from the products that they use and gives them legal rights to seek compensation. Under the Official Code of Georgia Annotated �51-1-11, consumers who are injured by a product do not need to prove that they had privity or purchased the product to have legal standing to file a lawsuit against the product�s manufacturer. Even if the injured party was borrowing the product from another party, they still have the right to file a lawsuit.

By hiring a Riverdale defective products attorney, victims could ensure that the right defendants are named in their lawsuit. Liability for the consumer’s injuries likely depends upon the type of defect the product has.

A design defect occurs with the original design of the product. If this defect applies, the defendant who created the product could be held liable. This type of defect is likely to affect many products.

With a manufacturing defect, the product was designed safely and correctly, but something went wrong during the manufacturing process. Because of this, the manufacturer could be held accountable in court.

If the manufacturer of a product fails to place proper warnings on the product or its packaging, they could be held liable. If a consumer is using the product the way it was intended and suffered harm that could have been avoided with an adequate warning, the manufacturer could be made to compensate the victim.

Consumers who suffer injuries from using a product could contact a defective products lawyer in Riverdale to help determine the value of their case. It is important to note that Georgia does not have damage caps in place that limit the amount of financial awards a plaintiff could receive.

However, the value of a claim depends upon the damages that the plaintiff suffers and how severe their injuries are. A defective products case with more severe injuries and extensive medical bills could garner a higher settlement or jury award. For help with recovering damages, seek the services of a dedicated lawyer.

An injury from a defective product has to potential cost a consumer tens of thousands of dollars and change the course of their life. If you were injured by a defective product, a Riverdale defective products lawyer could help you recoup your losses and even help you receive money for your pain and suffering. Call an attorney today to find out what your legal options are after sustaining an injury from a defective product.

pages.title: Riverdale Dog Bite Lawyer | Canine Injury | Negligent Pet Owners
pages.description: If you have been attacked by a dog, contact a Riverdale dog bite lawyer to discuss compensation for your injuries and to hold the owner responsible.
pages.content_md:
Bringing a claim to court is difficult in of itself. However, and as it pertains to Georgia, dog bite personal injury claims are not easy to substantiate. Victims not only need to have suffered an injury, but they must also demonstrate negligence.

Because of this, you need to consider retaining a Riverdale dog bite lawyer to prove the negligence of the dog�s owner. Retaining the services of an accomplished personal injury attorney could give you the peace of mind that your legal interests are being appropriately cared for while you heal.

Some states do not require victims to prove negligence on the part of the dog owner. Instead, the dog owner is strictly liable for any injuries the dog may cause. However, in Georgia, the victim of a dog bite must prove negligence on the part of the dog owner.

More specifically, they must prove that:

- The dog is dangerous or vicious
- The owner was careless with the dog or allowed it to roam “go at liberty” which lead to the plaintiff�s injury
- The plaintiff did not provoke the dog to bite

In places where there is leash ordinance enforcement, a dog simply being off leash could warrant negligence on the part of the dog owner. Because of this challenge, it may be best to retain the employ of a Riverdale dog bite lawyer.

For all claim holders, it is not enough to simply establish negligence in court when seeking compensation. Victims must also demonstrate damages�losses or injuries�to recover compensation. While negligence is wrong in and of itself, it generally does not warrant a lawsuit unless there are physical injuries for which a plaintiff could be compensated.

Plaintiffs often seek economic, or tangible and easily quantifiable, damages when bringing a claim to court. Medical expenses are one type of expense that defendants may be ordered to provide the plaintiff with compensation for. This might include an emergency room visit, hospitalization, or any generalized medical expense relating to the incident. Lost wages are another type of damage that dog bite victims could claim if they are missing work due to their injuries and recovery. A seasoned lawyer could fight for an injured victim’s right to damages.

In addition to the easily quantifiable damages, a dog bite victim may also claim non-economic damages. These are generally more difficult to prove and could include:

- Pain and suffering
- Loss of enjoyment of life
- Scarring
- Disfigurement
- Loss of consortium
- Stress or changes in personal relationships

Some states mandate a limit on how much a plaintiff could ask a jury for or receive in a dog bite case. Fortunately, Georgia is not one of these states.

In 2010, the Georgia Supreme Court determined that damage caps breach the right to a jury trial established by the state constitution. Therefore, a jury cannot impose limits on the plaintiff for non-economic claims. The lack of damage caps could help the plaintiff receive a higher settlement if the case is settled out of court.

Individuals who were bitten or otherwise injured due to a dog should consider reaching out to an experienced Riverdale dog bite lawyer. An attorney could provide case consultation and determine a favorable course of action for claim holders. Call today to get your dog bite case started.

pages.title: Riverdale Medical Malpractice Lawyer | Medical Negligence

pages.content_md:

In 2013, the Journal of the American Medical Association stated that medical negligence was the third highest cause of death in the United States. In 2012, over $3 billion was spent on medical malpractice settlements. The tragic reality is that medical malpractice is a genuine occurrence that can strike any American.

If you or someone you care for suffered injury from a doctor�s mistake, you might need an experienced personal injury attorney. A Riverdale medical malpractice lawyer could help guide you through the complex process of filing a claim and seeking financial recovery for your damages.

- Wrongful death
- Surgeon mistakes
- Misdiagnosis
- Infection
- Over-medication
- Failure to follow a living will
- Hospital stay negligence

Among many other maladies, these examples can bring about serious injury, chronic medical issues, and even death. Medical malpractice has the potential to change someone�s life forever and bring great financial cost upon those who are affected.

Those who have been affected by medical malpractice may face a severe financial burden, as the medical bills to treat complications from medical malpractice can be devastating to a patient�s financial security. Sometimes, those affected by medical malpractice also experience a loss of income due to an inability to work.

In addition to the financial burden, those affected by medical malpractice may suffer a tremendous loss of their personal wellbeing. Chronic physical pain, along with severe emotional and psychological trauma, can be lifelong struggles malpractice victims may face.

Those affected by this kind of maltreatment have a right to seek out any potential paths toward being compensated for their loss. A Riverdale medical malpractice attorney may be able to assist with the process of filing a lawsuit for these damages mentioned above and many more.

Anyone wishing to file a medical malpractice suit has a limited time in which to do so. Official Code of Georgia �9-3-71 imposes a two-year statute of limitations to file a medical malpractice suit under most circumstances, as well as a strict five-year over-arching statute of limitations for all such cases.

For those wishing to file a medical malpractice suit, some necessary steps need to be taken. Georgia state law requires that the plaintiff in a medical malpractice suit file a medical affidavit along with their initial complaint. This affidavit must be prepared by a qualified medical expert who can provide evidence that negligence took place, as per O.C.G.A. �9-11-9.1.

Filing a medical malpractice suit can be complex and difficult to achieve alone. Fortunately, a qualified medical mistreatment lawyer in Riverdale may be able to assist with the process of filing a claim for damages, as well as with any potential litigation that may occur.

If you or a loved one were harmed by medical malpractice, you are not alone. A Riverdale medical malpractice lawyer may be able to help you determine if there are grounds for you to file a civil suit and proceed effectively and efficiently through the process of pursuing fair compensation. Call today to schedule a consultation.

Motorcycle riding is a popular hobby and form of transportation for many Americans. Unfortunately, since motorcycles lack a support structure and have few safety measures built in to protect riders, severe injuries could often result from a collision with another vehicle.

If you or a loved one were injured in a motorcycle wreck, you might need a Riverdale motorcycle accident lawyer to help you with your case. For a property damage claim, individuals are granted a four-year statute of limitations, according to O.C.G.A. �9-3-32.

There may be exceptions to the statute of limitations for filing a personal injury or damages claim. For example, if the injury or damage is not immediately recognized, a plaintiff may still have grounds to file their claim. A dedicated Riverdale motorcycle accident lawyer may be able to help individuals determine the proper deadline to file a claim.

An injured party may still be eligible for compensation even if they contributed to the accident that harmed them. If the injured individual is found to be less than 50 percent responsible for the accident, they could still recover compensation in Georgia.

This means that the other party must have more responsibility for the accident occurring in order to be liable for the costs of the wreck. A knowledgeable motorcycle crash attorney in Riverdale could help determine liability and help an injured individual seek compensation from the responsible party.

While you likely do not expect to be involved in a motorcycle accident, when they do occur, disastrous consequences may follow. Psychological, physical and financial hardships often result after a motorbike crash.

If you or a loved one have been injured or experienced property damage in a motorcycle accident, a Riverdale motorcycle accident lawyer may be able to help you seek compensation from the party responsible for your accident. Call today to schedule a consultation.

pages.title: Riverdale Truck Accident Lawyer | Tractor Trailer Wrecks
pages.description: A Riverdale truck accident lawyer could help you recover compensation if you or a loved one were injured in a trucking collision.
pages.content_md:
At a minimum, being involved in a motor vehicle accident is enough to ruin your day. If the wreck was severe, the injuries that you sustain and the damage to your vehicle could create lasting problems. If you were hit by a truck, chances are that you will be dealing with the repercussions of the accident for a long time.

Being hurt in a truck wreck may not be all bad, as you may be able to recover the full compensation that you need and deserve after the collision. However, it often takes a Riverdale truck accident lawyer to ensure the proper legal mechanisms are used to ensure this happens. Reach out to a well-practiced personal injury attorney to learn your options.

The moments and days following a collision with a commercial vehicle can be chaotic and stressful. Above all else, people need to be sure to seek emergency care for their physical injuries. This helps to not only give a person the best chance to make a recovery, but it would also create a legal record of injuries that could be introduced as evidence.

However, individuals must also be sure to understand that they need to protect their legal rights. As soon as the accident occurs, the defendant driver, their employer, and their insurance company will be acting to gather evidence and build up their defense. The sooner that a plaintiff can begin to formulate their case and gather evidence, the better the chances of success.

People should also remember to act quickly, keeping in mind that the Official Code of Georgia �9-3-33 sets the time limit to pursue a claim at two years after the date of the collision. Contacting a Riverdale truck accident attorney can be a great first step. A lawyer can take care of all the details to protect a person�s legal rights while they focus on making their recovery.

It is an unfortunate fact that a truck accident can happen at almost any time, and most examples are unavoidable. A momentary lapse in judgment or an unexpected road condition can cause a trucker to lose control and careen into another vehicle. The resulting losses can be catastrophic.

One common source of truck accidents is inattentiveness. A trucker must keep their attention on the road at all times. Distractions that are the result of talking on the radio, texting, changing a radio station, or simple drowsiness can all lead to collisions.

Other collisions come about as a consequence of the truck itself. These vehicles weigh multiple tons, and are slow to stop in case of an emergency. A trucker who presses on the brakes may lose control, resulting in a rollover or jackknife. A Riverdale truck accident attorney could provide more information about the common causes of truck collisions.

The law in Riverdale aims to compensate individuals for all the injuries that they have suffered. While many of these injuries are physical in nature, there are also plenty of non-physical ways that victims of truck wrecks are likely to suffer.

Talking to a truck accident lawyer in Riverdale could be the best way to fully understand the legal damages for which an injured person deserves reimbursement. Many individuals could recover compensation for the following types of losses in a successful lawsuit:

- Medical expenses, both those from the past and those that are likely to be incurred in the future
- Professional repercussions, including lost wages, a reduced ability to earn an income, and business opportunities that were lost and that are associated with the accident
- Property damage sustained in the crash
- Compensation for the physical pain and the mental and emotional suffering related to the crash and the resulting recovery process

The force of a truck accident often leads to more property damage and more severe injuries to the individuals involved than other car crashes might. Fortunately, there are legal mechanisms that a Riverdale truck wreck lawyer could use to ensure that plaintiffs get the full compensation they need and deserve after being hit in a truck accident.

The most important of these is the legal doctrine of *respondeat superior*, which allows civil plaintiffs to hold an employer liable for the negligence of its employees when they are on the clock and acting within the scope of their employment. If a truck driver was carrying cargo and working at the time of the crash, *respondeat superior *could extend liability through the truck driver and to the company they were working for at the time of the accident.

This could be critical for victims of a truck accident, since truck drivers, even if insured, are rarely able to cover all of the costs of a significant crash. Conversely, the trucking company is far more likely to have the deep pockets necessary to pay for the plaintiff�s injuries. To learn more about establishing liability, contact a dedicated lawyer.

If you were hurt in a truck crash you were not primarily responsible for, legal representation is available that could help you pursue fair compensation. Reach out to a Riverdale truck accident lawyer today and schedule a consultation to learn your rights and how much compensation you should be entitled to receive.

Qualified legal counsel could advocate for your rights and negotiate with insurance companies to ensure that you obtain just compensation for your injuries. Depending on the circumstances, however, there are many legal reasons why an insurance company may deny an injured worker�s claim.

For example, under Official Code of Georgia Annotated �34-9-17, workers who were under the influence of alcohol, marijuana or another controlled substance when they were injured are not eligible to receive workers� compensation benefits. In the same vein, those who were involved in willful misconduct, trying to injure another, or refusing to comply with safety standards may be unable to receive benefits. It may be imperative for injured workers to discuss the circumstances of their injuries with an experienced workers� compensation lawyer in Riverdale to determine if they have a valid claim.

If you need help getting your workers� compensation claim approved, do not hesitate to consult with a skilled Riverdale worker�s compensation lawyer. Learn more about your workers� comp insurance rights by scheduling an initial consultation today.

pages.title: Riverdale Wrongful Death Lawyer | Fatal Accidents

pages.content_md:
A loss of a loved one could be a painful and overwhelming experience, and the financial burden that often gets left with a family after the passing of a loved one could make things even more difficult. Instead of going through this difficult time alone, let a committed Riverdale wrongful death lawyer help you and your family.

An empathetic personal injury attorney could work on your behalf and ensure that the necessary steps are taken to file a wrongful death claim. Following that, they could work diligently to help you pursue compensation from the responsible party.

There are key differences between a wrongful death claim and an estate claim. Each has its benefits, and each has a set of requirements that the filing party and any Riverdale wrongful death attorney they choose to retain must meet for a claim to be successful.

Official Code of Georgia �51-4-2 allows a deceased person�s spouses and children to pursue compensation for damages suffered as a result of their loved one�s wrongful death. The compensation they may be eligible to recover is based on the value of the life of the deceased.

Consequently, the compensation in a successful wrongful death claim typically includes reimbursement for the income the deceased would have made in their lifetime had the accident not occurred. Restitution may also be sought for the loss of enjoyment in life that surviving family members would have experienced.

In addition to a wrongful death lawsuit, an estate claim could also be filed against a wrongdoer or negligent party after a fatal accident. Also known as a survival action, this claim could only be pursued by the decedent�s estate and their representative. However, the damages that an estate claim could recover go beyond what a wrongful death claim may provide.

As an alternative to recovering compensation for the value of the life of the deceased person, an estate claim could recover the losses that the deceased individual suffered from the accident. For example, their estate could recover compensation for medical and funeral expenses, as well as their pain and suffering.

Family members and loved ones should note that there are limitations to when a wrongful death claim could be filed. O.C.G.A. �9-3-33 states that the statute of limitations for wrongful death and estate claims allows for only two years from the date of the incident in which to file a claim.

However, certain situations could alter this time frame. A skilled wrongful death lawyer in Riverdale could be essential to ensuring that the claim is filed within Georgia�s statute of limitations.

The loss of a loved one could be difficult for any family to handle. In addition to grief, you and your family may experience extreme financial stress. Seeking legal representation could be the most crucial step in getting justice for your loved one.

A Riverdale wrongful death lawyer could represent you through all parts of the legal process, from filing to settlements to potentially a civil trial. pages.title: Road to Safety: What the Latest Georgia Highway Report Reveals About Our Distracted Driving Habits - Parian Lawyers
pages.h1: Road to Safety: What the Latest Georgia Highway Report Reveals About Our Distracted Driving Habits
pages.content_md:
In October 2024, the Georgia Governor’s Office of Highway Safety reported that distracted driving

accounted for over 53% of all vehicle traffic accidents in 2022. In the Atlanta area, the highest rates of

distraction-related crashes occurred on principal arterial roads, such as I-75 and I-85. In more rural parts of Georgia, like Haralson and Carroll counties, most distraction-related crashes happened on collector roads, which are designed to move traffic from local streets to arterial roads.

Discussions about distracted driving often focus on cellphone use, but this is not the only form of

distraction. There are three types of distracted driving:

- Manual distractions involve physically interacting with something in the vehicle, such as eating,
 drinking, smoking, or adjusting the radio.
- Visual distractions involve looking at something other than the road, such as checking your phone,
 reading, or looking at a billboard.
- Cognitive distractions involve mental engagement with thoughts that distract you from driving, such as conversations, arguments, or loud noises inside or outside the vehicle.

It’s crucial to prioritize safety while driving and to recognize that these distractions are not worth

jeopardizing your well-being or that of others. Here are some steps you can take to prevent distracted

driving:

Prepare Before You Drive

- Adjust your settings: Set your GPS, climate controls, and mirrors before hitting the road.
- Organize your belongings: Keep necessary items like water or toll money within easy reach.
- Turn on “Do Not Disturb”: Use your phone’s do-not-disturb mode or apps that block notifications while driving.

Minimize Phone Usage

- Hands-free devices: Use Bluetooth or hands-free features if you must take a call.
- No texting or scrolling: Never text, check social media, or browse apps while driving.
- Plan stops for communication: If you need to send a message or call, pull over safely.

Limit Passenger Distractions

- Set expectations: Ask passengers to respect your focus on driving.
- Engage help when needed: Have passengers handle tasks like GPS adjustments or changing
 music.

Focus on the Road

- Stay alert: Continuously scan the road and be aware of your surroundings.
- Avoid multitasking: Eating, grooming, or managing tasks like paperwork should wait until you’re parked.

If you or a loved one has been injured due to the negligence of a distracted driver, Parian Lawyers is

here to help. Don’t suffer in silence. Our experienced attorneys will evaluate your case, free of cost. Call

us at (770) 562-7562.

Personal injury law can be difficult to understand. Georgia�s legislature has passed no laws defining how an injured person can collect damages from the at-fault party.

Instead, one must look to the common law for guidance. Common law, simply put, is built from decisions made by courts over a period of time, which that court will follow in the future.

As a result, core concepts of personal injury law, such as the definition of negligence, are defined through Georgia�s court rulings.

Our firm�s Rome Personal Injury Lawyers work with clients who have been injured through the negligence of others to fight for fair compensation for their injuries.

The vast majority of personal injury cases are the result of another person�s carelessness. While a plaintiff may certainly be injured as the result of a defendant�s intentional act, assault for instance, most personal injury cases arise as the result of accidents. Common examples of these accidents which a Rome injury attorney can assist with include:

In any of these cases, the plaintiff must be able to demonstrate that the defendant was negligent and thus caused their injuries.

Negligence is a core concept in personal injury law and can be simply defined as when a person has a legal responsibility to protect others, and as a result of failing in that responsibility, the protected person comes to harm.

However, the defendant may argue that the plaintiff was just as responsible for the accident. This is known as the contributory negligence defense and should be addressed with the assistance of a Rome personal injury lawyer.

In many jurisdictions, including Georgia, a defendant may argue that the plaintiff was just as responsible for the accident occurring as the defendant himself. This is known as contributory negligence.

In GA Code 51-11-7, it states that, �If the plaintiff by ordinary care could have avoided the consequences to himself caused by the defendant�s negligence, he is not entitled to recover.�

In other words, if the plaintiff is at least 50 percent responsible for the accident, the law will not hold the defendant liable. However, if the defendant is found to be 75 percent liable, he will be responsible to pay for 75 percent of the damages in the case.

Perhaps the most important aspect of personal injury law to keep in mind is the statute of limitations. These are gateway statutes that may allow a court to outright dismiss a claim if they are not followed. In short, they are a time limit within which a case must be filed at court.

For cases involving only losses to personal property, this limit is four years from the date of loss according to GA Code 9-3-32. Plaintiffs have only two years to file a suit for all cases alleging personal injury under GA Code 9-3-33.

Time is of the essence in all personal injury cases; contact our firm today to ensure that the statute of limitations is met.

When a person is injured in an accident, they may think that the insurance companies are there to help. However, the defendant�s insurance company�s goal is to pay out as little as possible, even when their client is at fault.

They understand the legal theory of contributory negligence and may attempt to strong-arm people by convincing them that the accident was more their fault than the defendant�s.

Our firm has extensive experience dealing with insurance companies, and will work hard to show that the other party�s actions were the true cause of the accident.

By compiling thorough and aggressive demand packages that consider all of the evidence in the case, most claims are settled quickly without the need for a trial.

However, in cases where a trial becomes necessary, our firm�s litigation team will stand by your side every step of the way and present your case to the jury with force and clarity. There is a limited time to file a claim for personal injury in Georgia so do not delay; contact our firm�s Rome personal injury lawyers today.

Getting into a bicycle wreck could be a frightening situation with overwhelming legal issues that follow. If you were hurt while riding your bike by someone driving a larger vehicle, hiring a Rome bicycle accident lawyer may provide you with the representation you need to approach and present a case for monetary compensation as effectively as possible.

Bicycle crash laws in Georgia may be tricky to navigate, and negative public opinion of bike riders could sometimes influence witnesses of an accident as well as professionals in the legal system. An experienced attorney who is committed to helping you may be able to guide you through the ordeal.

Georgia state law defines a bicycle as a vehicle. This technically makes every bike rider a car driver in the eyes of the law, which may mean bike riders are responsible for following traffic laws just as a car driver would.

Official Code of Georgia �40-6-56 states that cyclists must maintain a “safe distance” from vehicles, which is defined as three feet or more of separation. This rule also states that whenever possible, car drivers must keep the same safe distance from bike riders when passing or overtaking them while going in the same direction they are until they have safely passed them completely.

Unfortunately, some drivers leave the scene after bike crashes, either intentionally or because they do not realize someone was hurt. For injured bike riders, it may be difficult to remember details such as whether the driver kept a safe distance.

Plaintiffs could rely on a Rome bicycle accident lawyer to put together an accurate picture of their wreck after-the-fact. During this time, the injured individual could focus on healing from the pain they are experiencing, while their skilled attorney could help them pursue money to pay for damages as comfortably as possible.

A big fear for bike riders may be “dooring,” which is when a parked or stopped vehicle opens its door into a bike rider�s path before they could swerve out of the way. It is a particularly dangerous situation that may cause�bike riders to fall off their bike or veer into oncoming traffic, either of which could lead to serious crashes.

After a dooring incident, an injured bike rider may have the right to fight for compensation for any damages. However, the legal team representing the responsible driver could likely argue that the driver was not responsible. It also does not help that some Rome police officers may not be familiar with bicycle laws and might often ticket bike riders when they arrive at these scenes, even if the bike rider was the one who suffered injuries.

If a bike rider follows all the right laws while riding their bike�such as O.C.G.A. �40-6-296, which requires riders to ensure they are visible to other drivers with bright clothing, reflective strips, and/or lights between sunset and sunrise�they may not be held at fault and deserve compensation for their injuries. A bicycle accident attorney in Rome could help individual bike riders take stock of their damages and stand up for their rights in court.

Riders deserve as much respect in that context as any car driver would. The negative attitudes that many people hold toward bike riders could affect their judgment, especially in regards to the aftermath of wrecks. Often, this could mean people forget that bicycles are also vehicles under the law.

Hiring a Rome bicycle accident lawyer may be the best way to ensure you get a fair shake in court and could present your situation as accurately as possible. To learn more about what options might be available in your case, call today.

pages.content_md:
Being involved in a car accident, even a minor one, can have a lasting impact on a person�s life. On top of the obvious damage to your car and body, you may end up missing substantial time at work and may suffer through intense mental anguish.

Unfortunately, insurance companies only serve to complicate things by burying you in paperwork, only to offer you a token sum in an attempt to settle.

Our firm�s Rome car accident lawyers are here to protect your legal right to be compensated for injuries suffered as a result of a car accident. Our experienced injury lawyers will pursue your case with compassion and strength to bring you the fair compensation that you deserve.

People claiming damages as the result of a car accident will be filing a claim under the civil branch of the law. As opposed to the criminal branch, there are no statutes passed by the legislature defining exactly how a plaintiff should proceed. Instead, civil tort claims, such as in car accidents, are defined through the common law.

The common law is a series of precedents handed down by Georgia�s courts over the years. They provide guidance for people in legal situations, since the courts are bound to follow the rulings in previous decisions.

Through this process, we are given the requirements for civil claims alleging the most common avenue for compensation in car accidents: negligence.

There are five parts, or elements, that a plaintiff or their Rome car accident lawyer must prove in order to prevail in a negligence case. These are:

- Duty � In specific situations, the law places responsibility on people to protect others. This is not automatic and a person must take a voluntary step in order to assume duty. As applied to car accident cases, whenever any person operates a motor vehicle, they assume a duty to protect other drivers, passengers, and pedestrians. Because of this, duty is never in question in car accident cases.
- Breach � A breach of the duty of care occurs when the person who has the duty fails to protect other people. This can be by an action that they take, such as speeding, or by failing to act in a way that harms others, like failing to stop at a red light.
- Cause � The plaintiff must be able to prove that the breach of the duty of care was proximately responsible for their injuries.
- Scope � The injuries suffered by the plaintiff must have been foreseeable considering the facts of the case.
- Damages � Lastly, the plaintiff must suffer actual physical harm. While mental anguish can be added onto a claim, the case must have a foundation in physical injury.

One other thing to keep in mind for car accident cases is the statute of limitations. This is a time limit imposed upon plaintiffs for filing cases in court. If a plaintiff misses this deadline, their case has no chance of success.

For cases alleging property damage, the limit is four years from the date of the accident under GA Code 9-3-32. For any case alleging bodily injury, the limit is only two years, according to GA Code 9-3-33.

Whether you have been injured while driving your car or while riding as a passenger, you have the right to pursue legal action against the driver who is at-fault. Georgia�s laws concerning negligence allow injured people to seek damages for not just physical harm, but also for any lost wages or mental anguish.

Unfortunately, insurance companies who speak with unrepresented plaintiffs will attempt to minimize your injuries and offer token sums to quickly end the case. Take a positive step towards protecting your rights and let our firm�s Rome car accident lawyers fight for you.

We stand up to the insurance companies and present strong demand packages asking for full compensation for your injuries. Most cases are settled before a lawsuit becomes necessary, but if a trial is required, our litigators will argue your case before the jury with vigor.

Contact our firm today to see how we can help you to recover the compensation that you deserve.

Torts describe injuries suffered by people under the civil law and the appropriate remedy. The most common tort used to pursue motorcycle accident cases is negligence.

There are five parts of a negligence claim that a plaintiff must prove in order to win their Rome motorcycle accident case. They are:

- Duty � Usually, a person has no legal responsibility to care for the welfare of others. However, in certain situations, the law creates this responsibility. This is known as the duty of care. - Breach � If the person who carries the duty of care takes an action that results in another person coming to harm, the duty of care is said to be breached. Common examples of a breach of the duty of care in bike accidents include speeding, improper lane changes, and ignoring stop signs
- Cause � The injuries suffered by the plaintiff must have been caused by the breach of the duty of care by the defendants
- Scope � Any injuries suffered by the plaintiff must have been reasonably foreseeable from the facts of the case
- Damages � The plaintiff must suffer actual physical harm. Whether the harm is to property or one�s body, actual harm is required. Mental anguish can certainly be added to a claim, but is not enough to stand on its own

One other thing to remember is Georgia law concerning the statute of limitations. This is a time limit within which a plaintiff must file his case in court if they wish to prevail. If the case is not filed within this limit, the defendant can make a motion that the case be dismissed.

If the case alleges only losses to personal property, this limit is four years from the date of loss. For cases alleging personal injury and motorcycle accidents in Rome, the limit is shortened to two years.

If you have been injured as the result of a motorcycle accident, your focus should be on making a full recovery. pages.title: Rome Nursing Home Abuse Lawyer | Elderly Adults Abuse
pages.description: If you or a loved one have been subjected to nursing home abuse, consult a Rome nursing home abuse lawyer that could fight for justice for you.
pages.content_md:
With roughly 3.5 million nursing home residents living in nursing care facilities in the United States, nursing home abuse and neglect is a real problem that needs to be addressed and taken seriously, and one that will only become more apparent as nursing home populations increase.

If you or your loved one experienced nursing home abuse and neglect, an experienced Rome nursing home abuse lawyer can help hold abusive staff members and nursing home facilities accountable for their actions. Seek the services of a compassionate personal injury attorney that could fight for a positive outcome for you.

Physical abuse can take the form of beating, striking, slapping, pinching, kicking, hair pulling, pushing, and throwing residents to the floor. Many people are familiar with hidden camera videos exposing nursing home abuse, in which staff members are seen committing all sorts of physical abuse of residents, including burning them with cigarettes and striking them with objects.

The inappropriate use of restraints can also be physical abuse, including strapping residents to their beds or toilet chairs, or binding their feet or wrists.

The symptoms of physical abuse in a nursing home setting can be easy to hide if the bruises, marks, and contusions occur on parts of the body covered by clothing or gowns.

In addition, because older residents often have blood disorders and take blood thinner medications, they may bruise more easily, and signs of abuse may be dismissed as commonplace marks that occur on aging seniors during normal day-to-day activities.

Sexual abuse is less common in nursing homes than other forms of abuse, but it does occur. Potential signs of sexual abuse include sexually transmitted diseases, fear of a specific staff member, a relationship between a patient and staff member that seems inappropriate, and repeated bladder, yeast, or urinary tract infections.

Nursing home residents are vulnerable, and predatory staff members may find them easy targets. The residents may not understand what has happened to them, and the abuser may threaten them into keeping silent.

However, because staff members are in a position of authority over a nursing home resident, sexual relations of any kind between patients and staff are generally considered inappropriate, regardless of consent or lack thereof. An experienced Rome nursing home abuse lawyer could investigate the circumstances of any such abuse that has taken place.

When a nursing home resident experiences emotional trauma caused by a nursing home staff member, this may be considered mental and emotional abuse for which facility staff and administration could be held liable. This abuse can take the form of verbal abuse, name-calling, insults, mocking, and threats, as well as using personal information learned while caring for the resident against the patient. Unwarranted or excessive isolation can also be a form of emotional abuse, or�more commonly�a sign of neglect.

Nursing home neglect occurs when a resident’s needs are not taken care of, including when they are not given adequate food, socialization, medical care, and a comfortable and sanitary living environment. Some of the most common signs of nursing home neglect include the presence of bedsore on residents who have not been cared for properly, along with soiled clothes and linens and unchanged adult diapers.

When determining whether a nursing home resident is suffering neglect or abuse, it is important to remember that nursing home abuse can manifest in a variety of ways. Whether physical, sexual, mental, verbal, or emotional, all forms of abuse and neglect can have serious negative effects, and all claims of maltreatment should likewise be taken seriously. No matter what signs or symptoms you have witnessed regarding your loved one if you suspect nursing home abuse and neglect, a compassionate Rome nursing home abuse lawyer may know how to remedy it. Call today to schedule a consultation.

pages.title: Rome Pedestrian Accident Lawyer | Common Injuries
